bhāripurāṇa
__ maiṃ ādipurāṇa aura uttarapurāṇa kī saṃkṣipta kathā 'caubīsī purāṇa' ke nāma se likha cukā thā aura jinavāṇī-pracāraka kāryālaya, kalakattā se usakā prakāśana bhī ho cukā thā, ata: saṃkṣipta anuvāda karane kī merī ruci nahīṃ huī| phalataḥmaiṃne uttara diyā ki maiṃ saṃkṣipta anuvāda nahīṃ karanā cāhatā| hā~, śloka kā nambara dete hue mūlānugāmī anuvāda yadi āpa cāhate haiṃ to maiṃ kara de sakatā hū~|
kāpaḍa़iyājī kī dṛṣṭi meṃ samagra grantha kā parimāṇa nahīṃ āyā isalie unhoṃne prakāśita karane kā dṛḍha़ vicāra kiye binā hī mujhe anuvāda śurū karane kā antima patra de diyā| grīṣmāvakāśa kā samaya thā, ataḥ maiṃne anuvāda karanā śurū kara diyā | tīna varṣa ke grīṣmāvakāśoṃ-chaha māhoṃ meṃ jaba anuvāda kā kārya pūrā ho cukā taba maiṃne unheṃ sūcanā dī aura pūchā ki ise āpa presa meṃ kaba denā cāhate haiṃ| ādipurāṇa kā parimāṇa bāraha hajāra anuṣṭup śloka pramāṇa hai so itanā mūla aura itane ślokoṃ kā hindī anuvāda donoṃ hī milakara bṛhadākāra ho gaye ata: kāpaḍa़iyājī usake prakāśana se kucha pīche haṭane lage | mahaṃgāī kā samaya aura niyantraṇa hone se icchānusāra kāgaja prāpta karane meṃ kaṭhināī ye donoṃ kāraṇa kāpaḍa़iyājī ke pīche haṭane meṃ mukhya the|
isī samaya sāgara meṃ madhya prāntīya hindī sāhitya sammelana kā vārṣika adhiveśana hone vālā thā jisakī 'darśanapariṣad' kī vyavasthā kā bhāra mujha para avalambita thā| jaina darśana para bhāṣaṇa dene ke lie maiṃ jaina vidvānoṃ ko āmantrita karanā soca hī rahā thā ki usī samaya navaudghāṭita 'jaina aijyukeśana borḍa kī baiṭhaka bulāne kā bhī vicāra logoṃ kā sthira ho gayā| borḍa kī samiti meṃ aneka vidvān sadasya haiṃ | maiṃne sadasyoṃ ko saprema āmantrita kiyā jisameṃ paṃ0 vaṃśīdharajī indaura, paṃ0 rājakumārajī mathurā, paṃ0 mahendrakumārajī banārasa bādi aneka vidvān padhāra gaye| sāhitya sammelana aura jaina ejyukeśana borḍa donoṃ ke kārya sānanda sampanna hue | usake kucha hī māha pahale banārasa meṃ bhāratīya jñānapīṭha kī sthāpanā huī thī| paṃ0 mahendrakumārajī mūrti devī jaina granthamālā ke sampādaka aura niyāmaka haiṃ ataḥ maiṃne sāgara meṃ jñānapīṭha kī ora se ādipurāṇa prakāśita karane kī carcā paṃ. mahendrakumārajī se kī aura unhoṃne baḍa़ī prasannatā ke sātha jñānapīṭha se use prakāśita karanā svīkṛta kara liyā| sātha hī tāḍapatrīya tathā anya hastalikhita pratiyāṃ ekatrita kara unase pāṭhāntara lene kī suvidhā kara dī| itanā hī nahīṃ, tāḍapatrīya karnāṭaka lipi ko nāgarī lipi meṃ bā~canā tathā nāgarī lipi meṃ usakā rūpāntara karane ādi kī vyavasthā bhī kara dī| eka bāra pāṭhāntara lene ke lie maiṃ grīṣmāvakāśa meṃ 25 dina ke lagabhaga banārasa rahā taba āpane jñānapīṭha kī ora se suvidhā dī thī| dūsare varṣa meṃ banārasa nahīṃ pahu~ca sakā ataḥ āpane paṃ0 devakumārajī nyāyatīrtha ko banārasa se sāgara bheja diyā jisase hameṃ karnāṭaka lipi ke pāṭha sunane meṃ pūrṇa sahayoga prāpta huā| paṃ0 gulābacandra 'daṇḍī' vyākaraṇācārya, ema0 e0 se banārasa meṃ pāṭhabheda lene meṃ paryāpta sahayoga prāpta huā thā| isa prakāra 5-6 varṣoṃ ke pariśrama ke bāda ādipurāṇa kā vartamāna rūpa sampanna ho sakā hai| lalitakīti kṛta saṃskṛta ṭīkā tathā paṃ0 daulatarāmajī aura paṃ0 lālārāma jī kī hindī ṭīkāoṃ se mujhe sahāyatā prāpta huī | isalie mahānubhāvoṃ kā bhī maiṃ atyanta ābhārī hū~| unakī udāratā ke binā yaha mahān grantha janatā ke samakṣa ānā kaṭhina kārya thā| dūravartī hone se prūpha dekhane kā kārya maiṃ svayaṃ nahīṃ kara sakā hū~| isake samagra prūpha paṃ0 mahādevajī caturvedī vyākaraṇācārya ne dekhe haiṃ| mere vicāra se unhoṃne apanā dāyitva pūrī taraha nibhāyā hai| kucha aśuddhiyā~ avaśya raha gayī haiṃ para pāṭhakagaṇa adhyayana karate samaya mūla aura anuvāda kā milāna kara unheṃ ṭhīka kara leṃge, aisī āśā hai|
mahāpurāṇa kā dūsarā saṃskaraṇa ho rahā hai, yaha prasannatā kā viṣaya hai| mahāpurāṇa pahale saṃskaraṇa meṃ bhī saṃskṛta mūla, hindī anuvāda, mahattvapūrṇa prastāvanā aura pariśiṣṭa ādi ke sātha alaṃkṛta hokara sarvaprathama prakāśa meṃ āyā thā, isa dvitīya saṃskaraṇa meṃ kucha atirikta sudhāra-saṃśodhana aura parivartana-parivardhana kiye gaye haiṃ| pahale saṃskaraṇa ke mūla aura anuvāda meṃ jo truṭiyāṃ raha gayī thīṃ ve isa saṃskaraṇa meṃ sudhāra dī gayī haiṃ | prathama saṃskaraṇa prakāśita hone para bhūmikā ke 'ādipurāṇa aura varṇa-vyavasthā' śīrṣaka prakaraṇa para kucha anukūlapratikūla carcāeṃ uṭhī thīṃ unheṃ dṛṣṭigata rakhate hue usa prakaraṇa meṃ bhī āvaśyaka parivartana kara diye gaye haiṃ|
prastuta saṃskaraṇa meṃ kucha atirikta sāmagrī bhī joḍa़ī gayī hai| prastāvanā ke uparānta ādipurāṇa kī sūktiyā~ dī gayī haiṃ| aura grantha ke anta meṃ eka nayā pariśiṣṭa śabdānukramaṇikā ke nāma se joḍa़ā gayā hai| isake antargata ādipurāṇa meṃ āye bhaugolika, pāribhāṣika tathā vyaktivācaka śabdoṃ kī sūciyā~ dī gayī haiṃ| isa prakāra ke pariśiṣṭoṃ kī kitanī mahatī upayogitā hai, vaha adhyetāoṃ se chipī nahīṃ hai|
isa sampūrṇa rūpa meṃ prastuta saṃskaraṇa ko svādhyāya premioṃ, śraddhālu janatā tathā śodhārthī vidyārthī evaṃ vidvānoṃ sabhī ke lie upayogī banāne kā prayatna kiyā gayā hai|
hamāre mitra śrī ratanalāla jī kaṭāriyā kekaḍa़ī eka adhyayanaśīla vidvāna haiṃ| bārīkī se kisī cīja kā adhyayana karanā unakī prakṛti hai| patra likhane para unhoṃne pūrvabhāga meṃ rahī kamiyoṃ kī ora hamārā dhyāna ākarṣita kiyā, isake lie maiṃ unakā ābhārī hū~|
anta meṃ isa namra prārthanā ke sātha prastāvanā samāpta karatā hū~ ki mahāpurāṇa samudra ke samāna gaṃbhīra hai | isake anuvāda, saṃśodhana aura sampādana meṃ truṭiyoṃ kā raha jānā sahaja saṃbhava hai |ataḥ vidvajjana mujhe alpajña jānakara kṣamā kareṃge|

yadyogāccaturthī syādityākāṅkṣāyāṃ viśeṣyaṃ nirdiśatiśrīmata iti | puṇyavataḥ puruṣān śrayatīti śrīlakṣmīḥ sā ca bahiraṅgāntaraṅgabhedād dvividhā | tatra bahiraṅgalakṣmīḥ samavasaraṇādiramyantaralakṣmīḥ kevalajñānādistayorubhayorapi śrīriti grahaṇam, jātyapekṣayā tathā grahītuṃ suśakatvāt | yadyapyabhyudayalakṣmī rājādhirājārddhamaṇḍalīkamaṇḍalīkārddhacakradharahaladharasakalacakradharakuliśadharatīrthakarasatkarmadharā. disaṃbandhabhedenānekadhā tathāpi niratiśayayoḥ prakṛtobhayalakṣmyorevātra grahaṇam | niratiśayā uktalakṣaṇā śrīlakṣmī- . rasyāsti 'śrīmān' iti, niratiśayātiśayārthe matovidhānāt | tābhyāmatiśayitāyā lakṣamyā asambhavāta na kevalametasminnevārthe bahiraṅgalakṣamyā saṃsarge'ntaraṅgalakṣmyā nityayoge'pi matovidhānamunnetavyam bhūmanindāpraśaṃsāsu nityayoge'tiśāyane | saṃsarge'stī' tyādivacanāt | yadyapi saptatiśatakarmabhūmiṣu tīrthakareṣu sarveṣvapyetat pravṛttinimittamāśritya śrīmadvyavahāro jāghaṭīti tathāpyetat kṣetrakālendrādivṛddhavyavahāratatpurāṇādisāmagrīmāśritya tatraiva tadvyavahārasya prasiddhiḥ | tasya mahābhāgadheyasyāṣṭottarasahasranāmadheyeṣu "śrīmān svayambhūvaṣabhaḥ” ityādiṣu sakalasaṃjñājīvātutvena tasyaiva puraskṛtatvāt | tathāpyabhidhānamāśritya śrīmacchabdasya prajāpatiśrīpativāvapatiśrīghanādiṣu āptābhāseṣvapi vyavahārasaṃbhavāt, tebhyo nama iti syāt, tadvyudāsāya viśeṣaṇamāha-sakaleti | sakalaṃ sarvadravyaparyāyagataṃ ca tajjñānaṃ ca sakalajñānaṃ kevalajñānamiti yāvat, 'sarvadravyaparyāyeṣu kevalasya' iti sūtraṇāta | tadevābhedena cakravatitvapadavyā rūpyate sakalajñānameva sāmrājyapadaṃ sakalajñānasāmrājyapadaṃ tathā tenābhedena sakalajñānasya nirūpaṇena lokottaratvātidurlabhatvajagatsāratvāditanmāhātmyasya loke'pi prakaṭanaprayojanasya sughaṭatvāt | tadīyuṣe jagmuṣe, prāptavate kila | anena tadvyudāsaḥ kathamiti cet ? antarbahirvastunaḥ kathaṃcita dravyaparyāyātmakasya suniścitāsaṃbhavadbādhakapramāṇena astitvasādhanāt | sarvathā dravyamātrasya paryāyamātrasya vā sarvathā vibhinnatavayasya abhinnatavayasya vā suniścitāsaṃbhavatsādhakapramāṇena khapuṣpavanāstitvasiddhaḥ|
"abhedabhedātmakamarthatattvaṃ tava svatantrānyataratkhapuṣpam" iti samantabhadrasvāmivacanāt | tathā cārthābhāsagrāhiṇāṃ āptābhāsānāṃ sarvajñābhāsatvena teṣāṃ sakalajñānetyādinā vyudāsāt | na ca tairupacaritasarvajñaḥ paramārthasarvajñasya vyabhicāraḥ, atipaṃgāt | yenābhidhānasiddhaśrīmadvyavahāreṇa tebhyo'pi nama: syāt | tathāpi siddhaparameṣṭhinānakāntaḥ tasyāpi kevalākhyāmakevalāṃ śriyamanubhavataḥ śrīmatsakalajñāna ityādiviśeṣaṇasabhāvāt |

prathamaṃ parva
vaha uttama kṣamā ādi daśa dharmoṃke cakra arthāt samūhako dhāraṇa karate haiṃ | upādhyāya parameṣṭhīke pakṣameṃ 'bhatrai' padakā artha upādhyāya kiyā jātā hai; kyoṃki vaha ajñānāndhakārase dūra haṭākara samyagjñānarūpī sudhāke dvārā saba jīvoṃkā bharaṇa-poṣaṇa karate haiṃ aura sādhu parameṣṭhīke pakṣa meṃ 'saṃsārabhīmuṣe' śabdakā artha sādhu liyā jātā hai kyoṃki vaha apanī siṃhavṛttise saṃsārasambandhī bhayako naṣṭa karanevāle haiṃ |
isa ilokameṃ jo ‘śrīmate' ādi pada haiṃ unameṃ jātivācaka honese ekavacanakā pratyaya lagāyā gayā hai ataḥ bhūta bhaviṣyat vartamāna kālasambandhī samasta tīrthaṃkaroṃko bhī isī lokase namaskāra siddha ho jātā hai | bharata cakravartīke pakṣa meṃ isa prakāra vyākhyāna hai-jo navanidhi aura caudaha ratnarūpa lakṣmīkā adhipati hai, jo sakalajñānavān jīvoṃke saṃrakṣaṇarūpa sāmrājyapadako prāpta hai, (sakalāśca ye jñāśva sakalajñāḥ, sakalajñānām asaṃ jīvanaṃ yasmiṃstat tathābhūtaṃ yatsāmrājyapadaṃ tad īyuṣe ) jo pūrva janmameṃ kiye hue dharmake phalasvarūpa cakraratnako dhāraṇa karatā
“siddho lokottarābhikhyāṃ kevalākhyāmakevalām | anūpamāmanantāṃ tāmanubobhūyate śriyam ||” iti vādī masinoktatvāt |
tathā ca pratijñāhāniḥ jīvanmuktasyātrādhikṛtatvāt ityatrāha dharmacakreti | dvitīya divasakarā pratibimbabimbaśaṅkākarajājvaladdharmacakrāyudhaṃ bibharti dharmacakrabhṛt " sphuradarasahasrasurucira" ityādi pravacanāt "dharmacakrāyudho devaḥ” iti vacanācca tasmai | jīvanmuktasyaiva dharmacakrāyudhena yoga iti prakṛtārthasyaiva svīkaraṇāt | anena tadavinābhūtaṃ samavasaraṇādikamapyupalakṣitam | athavā viśeṣyasya ubhayalakṣmīramaṇatvasya vyāvarṇanayā etaddvayaṃ saṃbhavadviśeṣaṇaṃ "sambhavavyabhicārābhyāṃ syādviśeṣaṇamarthavat" iti nyāyāt |
kiṃ ca sakalajñānasāmrājyapadaprāptiḥ kasyāyudhasya dhāraṇayetyatra dharmeti | dharmaḥ caritram "cāritaṃ khalu dhammo " iti kundakundasvāmibhinirūpitatvāt | tadatra prakaraṇabalāt yathākhyātacāritraṃ tadeva cakramiva cakraṃ durjayaghātikarmārinirjayena sakalasāmrājyapadaprāptihetutvāt | tatsadā birbhāta iti dharmacakrabhṛt tasmai, anena yathārupātacāritrasya ghātikarmārinirjayena sakalajñānasāmrājyapadaprāpteḥ sādhyasādhanabhāvaḥ kathaṃcinniratiśayaṃ sānugrāhakatvaṃ copaḍhokitam |
nanu niratiśayaṃ parānugrāhakeṇāpi bhavitavyam | yataḥ tannamaskāraḥ pamphulītītyatrāha - bhartre iti | viśvaṃ jagat birbhāta puṣṇātyevaṃśīlo bhartā tasmai bhartre viśvasya jagataḥ svāmine poṣaṇaniratāya, anena apārānugrahaśīlatvamuktam | kuto'yaṃ niratiśayaṃ parānanugṛhṇātīti niścayaḥ ? ityatrottarayati " saṃsāreti” | atra “guravo rājamāṣā na bhakṣaṇoyāḥ" ityādivat saṃsāriṇāṃ saṃsārabhī muṭtvādihetugarbhaviśeṣaṇena uttaramiti nirṇayaḥ | svabhartṛ tvasya svasaṃsārabhī muṭtvasya ca prāguktaviśeṣaṇadvayenaiva vyajyamānatvāt | 'kṣudhātṛṣājananamaraṇādinānāghoraduḥkhānāmākaraḥ saṃsāraḥ bhava iti yāvat | " kṣuttṛṣṇa| śvāsakāsajvara maraṇajarāriṣṭayogapramohavyāpatyādyugraduḥkhaprabhavabhavahate" riti pūjyapādernigaditvāt | tasmādbhoḥ tāṃ muṣṇāti luṇṭayatīti saṃsārabhīmuṭ tasmai | atra saṃsāriṇāṃ saṃsārabhayaluṇṭākatvavyāvarṇanayā nirāyāsena saṃsārabhayāpaharaṇadakṣacāturyātiśayaḥ prakāśitaḥ tīrthakara - satkarmaṇaḥ tasya tādṛgvivātiśayasya durvārasaṃsāravicchedopāya niyukta divyadhvanipravartanāmātreṇaiva saṃsiddheḥ | tadevaṃ viśvavidyāparameśvarasya viśvasya jagataḥ samyak samuddharaṇapāṇḍityaparākāṣṭhāmadhiṣṭhitasya paramāptasyādibrahmaṇaḥ pāramaiśvaryaṃ caturalaukika jane'pi prathayituṃ śrīmatsāmrājyapadacakrabhūt bhartṛ bhīmudṛpadaprayogasāmarthyādbharatacakradharava ditīva śruterabhāvācca vyaṅgyatayā bharatacakradhareṇopamālaṅkāraḥ prathate | tathā hi-yathābhūtasaṃrakṣaṇā dikṣātradharmasya rakṣitayakṣasahasracakraratnasya ca dhāraṇayā dharmacakrabhṛt bharatacakravartī |

ādipurāṇam
hai, (dharmeṇa-purākṛtasukṛtena prāptaṃ yaccakraṃ tad bibhartīti tasmai ) jo, ṣaṭkhaṇḍa bharatakṣetrakī rakṣā karanevālā hai aura jisane saṃsārake jīvoṃkā bhaya naṣṭa kiyā hai athavā ṣaṭkhaṇḍa bharatakṣetrameṃ saba ora bhramaṇa karanemeṃ jise kisī prakārakā bhaya nahīṃ huā hai ( samantāt saraṇaṃ bhramaṇaṃ saṃsārasta smina bhiyaṃ muṣṇātīti tasmai ) athavā jo samīcīna cakrake dvārā sabakā bhaya naṣṭa karanevālā hai ( araiḥ sahitaṃ sāraṃ cakraratnamityarthaḥ, samyaka ca tata sārakha saṃsāraṃ tena bhiyaṃ muṣṇātīti tasmai ) aise tadbhavamokṣagāmī cakradhara bharatako namaskāra hai |
bāhubalīke pakṣameṃ nimna prakāra vyākhyāna hai-jo bharata cakradharako trividha yuddha meṃ parāsta kara adbhuta śauryalakṣmīse yukta hue haiṃ jo dharmake dvārā athavā dharmake lie cakraratnako
athavā kaivalyādyudayatraye nivedite dharmameva baha manvānā kaivalyapūjāṃ vidhāya 'saṃcitadharmā tadanucakra pūjayāmāseti' smatedharmādanantaraṃ cakraratna biti-puṣṇāti-pūjayati-dharatīti vā dharmacakrabhṛditi bharata eva procyate | sa ca samyagdarśanādirūpadharmasampattyā navanidhyādijanitārthasampattyā subhadramahādevyādivastu kṛtakāmasampattyā "śromān" ādibrahmopadiṣṭakalāsahitajñānapadaprāptyā sāmrājyapadaprāptyā ca sakalajñānasāmrājyapadamāptavān ṣaṭkhaṇḍabhūmaṇḍalasvāmitvena bhartā saṃkṣobheṇa sārayanti itastato gamayanti janān iti ṇijantātkartari yaci, saṃsārāścoracaraṭamantrayādayo (?) rāṣṭrakaṇṭakāḥ tebhyo janatānāṃ bhiyaṃ svapratāpena muṣṇātīti saṃsārabhīmuṭ janatāyāḥ namasyāśrayo bhavati | tathā saddharmacakravartitvena cakrabhṛdayaṃ āditīrtheśvaraḥ, bahiraṅgalakṣmyā saṃyuktatvena antaraṅgalakṣmībhinityayuktatvena śrīmān gaṇadharāhamindradevendracakravādiprārthanīyaṃ sakalajñānasāmrājyapadamadhitiṣṭhan trijagato bhartā janatāyā ājavaṃjavadasyubhayaluṇṭākatvena saṃsārabhīmuḍ-anantānantasukhadāyakasya mahāpuruṣasya namasyāśrayo na syād iti |
athavā ṣaṭkhaṇḍabhata cakradharātrijagatsvāminaḥ śrīmata ityādiṣu sarvatrādhikyāt vyatirekālaṅkāro vā dhvanyate, sādṛśyamātrāpekṣayā prāgupamālaṅkārasya prakāśitatvāt | nanvevaṃvidhaprathamānuyogamahāśāstrasyādau pañcaparameṣṭhināṃ namaskāraṃ bhagavānācāryaḥ kuto nāṅgīcakāra bhūtabalibhaṭṭārakarmahākarmaprakṛtiprābhūtadravyānuyogamahāśāstrasyādāvanādisiddhapañcamahāśabdaiḥ pañcaparameṣṭhināṃ namaskārakaraṇādityākāṅkṣāyāṃ śrīmadityādi pañcapadaratnapradīpāḥ pañcaparameṣṭhināṃ prakāśakatvena namaḥ śikhayā prajvalantītyāha śrīmata ityādi "śrīmate namaḥ" | evaṃ sarvatra saṃbaddhavyam | śrīrāhantyamahimāghātikarmārinirjayaprādurbhūtanavakevalalabdhyādyātmā 'śrīrārhantyamahimeti' nyāsakāravacanāt | sā'syāstīti śrīmān tasmai śrīmate namaḥ, arhate namaḥ, 'ṇamo arahaṃtāṇaṃ' iti yāvat
"kevalaṇāṇadivāyarakiraṇakalāvappaṇāsiaṇṇāṇo | ṇavakevalalajhuggamasujaṇiyaparamappavavaeso|"
ityahallakṣaṇapratipādakapravacanasadbhāvāt | anantānantasvavibhāgaḥ saṃpūrṇatvāt sakalaṃ tacca tajjñānaṃ ca sakalajñānam upalakṣaṇāt samyagdarśanādisaptaguṇānāṃ grahaṇaṃ tatastatsahitaṃ tadeva sāmrājyapadaṃ guṇāṣṭakasāmrājyapadamiti yāvat | athavā sakalaiśśeṣairaśeṣarekārthasamavāyibhiḥ kṣāyikasamyagdarśanādisaptaguṇaḥ sahitaṃ ca tajjñānaṃ ca sakalajñānaṃ tadeva sāmrājyapadam | athavā sakalajñānāmanantānantānāṃ sarvajñānām āna: prāṇanaṃ viśuddhacaitanyamayabhāvaprāṇarjīvanamati sakalajñānaḥ tanavātastvevamucyate tadeva sāmrājyapadaṃ sakalajñānasāmrājyapadaṃ tadīyaviṣaye prāptavate namaḥ siddhaparameṣṭhine namaḥ ṇamo siddhāṇamiti' yāvat | "aṭūguṇā kidakiccā loyaggaṇivāsiṇo siddhā" iti pravacanāt | svayamācarana. dharmaḥ samyagdarśanācārādipañcācārya thāyathaṃ cakraṃ dvādaśagaṇaṃ bibhartīti dharmacakrabhat gaṇadhara ācāryavṛṣabhaḥ tasmai dharmacakrabhate namaḥ ācāryaparameṣṭhine namaḥ ‘ṇamo āiriyāṇamiti'yāvat | “pañcamuktyai svayaṃ ye ācārānācarantaḥ paramakaruṇayācārayante mumukṣan lokāgragaṇyaśaraṇyān gaṇadharavṛṣabhān" ityāśādharanirūpaṇāt | ṣaḍdranyasaptatattvādīnāṃ sadopadeśenaiva mumukṣan bitti

prathamaṃ parva
dhāraṇa karanevāle bharata ke stavana ādise kevalajñānarūpa sāmrājyake padako prāpta hue haiṃ | eka varṣake kaṭhina kāyotsargake bāda bharata dvārā stavana ādi kiye jānepara hī bāhubalī svāmīne niḥśalya ho śukladhyāna dhāraṇa kara kevalajñāna prāpta kiyā thā| jo ibhatrai - ( iśvāsau bhartā ca tasmai ) kāmadeva aura rājā donoṃ haiṃ athavā ībha ( yā bhartā tasmai ) - lakṣmī adhipati haiṃ aura karmabandhanako naṣṭa kara saṃsārakā bhaya apaharaṇa karanevāle haiṃ aise śrī bāhubalī svāmīko namaskāra ho |
isa pakṣa meṃ ślokakā anvaya isa prakāra karanā cāhie - śrīmate, dharmacakrabhṛtā, sakala - jñānasāmrājyapadamīyuṣe, saṃsārabhīmuṣe, ibhartre namaḥ |
vṛṣabhasena gaṇadharake pakṣa meṃ vyākhyāna isa prakāra hai | śrīmate yaha pada caturthyanta na hokara saptamyanta hai - ( śriyā - syādvādalakṣmyā upalakṣitaṃ mataṃ jinaśāsanaṃ tasmin ) ataeva jo syādvādalakṣmīse upalakṣita jinaśāsana - arthāt śrutajñānake viṣayameṃ parokṣa rūpase samasta padārthoṃko jānanevāle jñānake sāmrājyako prāpta haiṃ, jo dharmacakra arthāt dharmoke samūhako dhāraṇa karanevāle haiṃ—padārthoṃke ananta svabhāvoṃko jānanevāle haiṃ, munisaṃgha adhipati haiṃ.
puṣṇātītyevaṃśīlo bhartā tasmai bhartre namaḥ upādhyāyaparameṣṭhine namaḥ ' ṇamo uvajjhāyāṇamiti' yāvat | "jo rayaṇatayajutto ṇiccaṃ dhammovadesaṇe ṇirado | so utrajhāo appā jadivarausa ho ṇamo tassa" ityāgamāt | saddhyānanilīnaḥ san darśanajñānasamagrabhāvamokṣasya sādhakatamaṃ viśuddhacāritraṃ nityaṃ sādhayan yatīndro bhāvasaṃsārabhiyaṃ muṣṇātīti saṃsārabhīmuṭ tasmai saṃsārabhīmuṣe namaḥ sādhuparameṣṭhine namaḥ ' ṇamo loe savvasāhūṇamiti' yāvat | "daṃsaṇaṇāṇasamaggaṃ maggaṃ mokkhassa johu cāritaṃ | sāhayadi suddhaṇicvaṃ sāhū sa muṇī ṇamo tassa ||" iti pravacanāt | atra — itarapadavat caturthīvibhaktyantatvena padatvaṃ hitvā sakalajñānasāmrājyapadamiti vyāsavacanaṃ tu matamahātiśayajñāpanārthaṃ pratijñāvacanamācāryasyeti brūmaḥ | tathāhi sakalatattvavyavasthājīvātusyādvādāmoghalāñchanalāñchitatvena sarvabādhāvidhurasādhana sādhitatvena sarvodayavattvena ca śrīmadarhanmaṃtaṃ tīrtha śrīmataṃ "sarvodayaṃ tīrthamidaṃ - taveda" iti yuktyanuśāsanāt | tasmin śrīmata eva sakalajñānasāmrājyapadaṃ śrīmattvānyathānupapatteriti | tadīyuṣe iti saṃbandhaḥ | atra purāṇe na kevalamāditīrthaṃkara : bharatadharma cakrabhṛcchalā kāpuruṣaśca pratipādyata iti prakāśitaḥ | aradānayanṛpatiprabhṛtidhārmikottaṃso jano'pīti pratipādyārtha prakāśayati śrīmata iti | śrīmatiparyāyo'syāstīti śrīmataḥ “abhrādibhyaḥ" ityadvidhānāt dānaśreyo nṛpatirityarthaḥ tasya śrīmaticaratvāt tasmin sati sakalajñānasāmrājyapadanīyuṣe iti saṃbandhaḥ ityanena nānākathāsaṃbandho dānatīrthakaraśca pratipādya iti prakāśitaḥ |
"jīyājjino jagati nābhinarendrasūnuḥ śreyān nṛpaśca kurugotragṛhapradīpaḥ |
yābhyāṃ babhūvaturiha vratadānatīrthe sārakrame paramadharmarathasya cakre ||"

13 āptapāśamatānyanye kavayaḥ poṣayantyalam | kukavitvād varaṃ teṣāmakavitvamupāsitam ||72|| anabhyastamahāvidyāḥ kalāśāstrabahiṣkṛtāḥ | kāvyāni kartu mohante kecitpaśyata sāhasam ||73|| tasmādabhyasya śāstrārthānupāsya ca mahākavīn | dhayaṃ śasyaṃ yaśasyaṃ ca kāvyaṃ kurvantu dhīdhanāḥ ||7|| pareṣāṃ dūṣaṇājātu na bibheti kavīśvaraḥ | kimulūkamayāda dhunvan dhvāntaṃ nodeti 'mānumān ||75|| pare tuṣyantu vā mā vā kaviḥ svārtha pratīhatām | na parārādhanācche yaḥ śreyaḥ sanmārgadeśanāta ||6|| purāṇakavayaḥ kaṃcit kaṃcinnavakavīśvarāḥ| teṣāṃ matāni mināni kastadārādhane kṣamaḥ ||7|| kecit sauśabyamicchanti kecidarthasya saṃpadam | kecit samāsabhūyastvaṃ pare byastā padāvalīm ||7|| mṛdubadhārthinaḥ kecit sphuṭabandhaiṣiṇaḥ pare | madhyamāḥ kecidanyeṣāṃ ruciranyaiva lakṣyate ||79|| iti bhinnābhisandhivā harārādhā manīṣiṇaḥ | "pṛthagjano'pi sūkānāmanabhijñaḥ sudurgrahaḥ ||8|| satīmapi kathā ramyāṃ dūṣayantyeva durjanāḥ | bhujaṅgā iva sacchāyāṃ candanamavallarīm ||8||
bahukuṭumbī vyaktike samāna dukhī hote haiṃ ||71|| kitane ho kavi apanī kavitā-dvārā kapila ādi āptābhāsoṃke upadiṣṭa matakā poṣaṇa karate haiṃ-mithyāmārgakā pracāra karate haiṃ| aise kaviyoṃkā kavitā karanā vyartha hai kyoṃki kukavi kahalānekī apekṣā akavi kahalānā hī acchā hai ||72|| kitane hī kavi aise bhī haiṃ jinhoṃne nyāya, vyākaraṇa ādi mahāvidyāoṃkā abhyāsa nahīṃ kiyā hai tathā jo saṃgīta ādi kalāśāstroṃke jñānase dūra haiṃ phira bhī ve kāvya karanekī ceṣṭā karate haiṃ, aho! inake sāhasako dekho ||73|| isalie buddhimānoṃko śāstra aura arthakā acchī taraha abhyāsa kara tathā mahākaviyoṃkī upāsanā karake aise kāvyakī racanā karanī cāhie jo dharmopadeśase sahita ho, praśaṃsanīya ho aura yaśako baḍha़ānevālā ho ||74|| uttama kavi dūsaroṃke dvārā nikāle hue doṣoṃse kabhī nahīṃ ḍaratā| kyā andhakārako naṣṭa karanevālā sūrya ulūkake bhayase udita nahīṃ hotā ? ||75|| anyajana santuṣṭa hoṃ athavā nahīṃ kaviko apanā prayojana pūrṇa karaneke prati hī udyama karanā cāhie| kyoṃki kalyāṇakī prāpti anya purupoṃkī ārādhanāse nahīṃ hotī kintu śreṣṭha mārgake upadeśase hotī hai ||76|| kitane ho kavi prācīna haiṃ aura kitane hī navīna haiṃ tathā una sabake mata jude-jude haiṃ ataḥ una sabako prasanna karane ke lie kauna samartha ho sakatā hai ? ||77| kyoṃki koī śabdoṃkī sundaratāko pasaṃda karate haiṃ, koī manohara arthasampattiko cāhate haiṃ, koī samāsakī adhikatāko acchā mānate haiṃ aura koī pṛthak-pṛthak rahanevālo alamasta padāvalīko hī cāhate haiṃ ||78|| koī mṛdula-sarala racanāko cāhate haiṃ, koī kaṭhina racanāko cāhate haiṃ, koī madhyama śreṇīko racanā pasanda karate haiṃ aura koī aise bhī haiṃ jinakī ruci savase vilakṣaṇa-anokhī hai ||79|| isa prakāra bhinna-bhinna vicāra honeke kāraṇa buddhimāna puruṣoṃko prasanna karanā kaṭhina kārya hai | tathā subhāṣitoṃse sarvathā aparicita rahanevāle mūrkha manuṣyako vaśameṃ karanā unakī apekṣā bhī kaṭhina kārya hai ||80|| duṣṭa puruṣa nirdoṣa aura manohara kathāko bhī dūṣita kara dete haiṃ, jaise candanavṛkṣakī manohara kāntise yukta nayī kopaloṃko sarpa dūṣita kara dete haiṃ || 81 ||

31 vijñāpyamanyadapyasti samādhāya manaḥ śṛṇu | 'yato bhagavataścittaṃ dṛḍhaṃ syānmadanugrahe ||21|| purā caritamajñānānmayā duścaritaṃ mahat | tasyainasaḥ praśāntyartha prāyaścittaṃ carāmyaham || 22|| hiṃsānṛtānyarairāmāratyārammaparigrahaiḥ | mayā saṃcitamaśaṃna puraino nirayocitam ||23|| kṛto munivadhānandastīto mithyādṛśā mayā | yenāyuṣkarma durmocaṃ baddhaṃ śvābhrīṃ gāteṃ prati ||24|| tatprasīda vimo vaktumāmūlāt pāvanī kathām | niṣkrayoṃ duṣkṛtasyāstu mama puṇyakathāśrutiḥ ||25|| iti praśrayiṇī vācamudīrya magadhādhipaḥ | vyaramadaśanajyotsnākṛtapuṣpārcanastutiḥ ||26|| tatastamṛṣayo dīptatapolakṣmīvibhūṣaṇāḥ | praśaśaṃsuriti prītā dhārmikaṃ magadheśvaram ||27|| sādhu bho magadhādhīśa! sādhu prabhavidāṃ vara!| pṛcchatādya tvayā tattvaṃ sādhu naḥ prīṇitaṃ manaḥ ||28|| "pipṛcchiṣitamasmāmiryadeva paramārthakam | tadevāya tvayā pṛṣṭaṃ saṃvādaḥ paśya kīdṛśaḥ ||29|| 'bubhusāvedana' praśnaḥ sa te dharmo bubhutsitaḥ | tvayā bubhutsunā dharma "viśvameva bubhutsitam ||30||
paśya dharmatarorarthaḥ phalaṃ kāmastu tadrasaḥ | satrivargatrayasyāsya mūlaṃ "puṇyakathāśrutiḥ ||31|| yaha purāṇa kahie ||20|| he bhagavan , isake sivāya eka bāta aura kahanī hai use citta sthira kara suna lījie jisase merā upakāra karane meṃ āpakā citta aura bhī dṛḍha़ ho jāye ||2|| vaha bāta yaha hai ki maiṃne pahale ajñānavaśa baḍa़e-baḍa़e durācaraṇa kiye haiṃ| aba una pāpoṃkī śāntike lie hī yaha prāyaścitta le rahā hū~ ||22|| he nātha, mujha ajñānīne pahale hiṃsā, jhūṭha, corī, parastrīsevana aura aneka prakārake ārambha tathā parigrahādike dvārā atyanta ghora pāpoṃkā saṃcaya kiyā hai |23|| aura to kyā, mujha mithyādṛṣṭine munirājake vadha karane meṃ bhī baḍa़ā ānanda mānā thā jisase mujhe naraka le jānevāle narakāyu karmakā aisā bandha huā jo kabhī chūṭa nahīṃ sakatā |24|| isalie he prabho, usa pavitra purāṇake prārambhase kahane ke lie mujhapara prasanna hoie kyoṃki usa puṇyavardhaka purāṇake sunanese mere pāpāṃkā avaśya hī nirākaraṇa ho jāyegā ||25|| isa prakāra dā~toṃkī kāntirūpī puṣpoṃke dvārā pūjā aura stuti karate hue magadhasamrāṭ vinayake sātha ūpara kahe hue vacana kahakara cupa ho gaye ||26||
tadanantara śreṇikake praśnase prasanna hue aura tīvra tapaścaraṇarūpī lakṣmīse śobhāyamāna munijana nīce likhe anusāra una dharmātmā śreṇika mahārājakī praśaṃsā karane lage ||27|| he magadheśvara, tuma dhanya ho, tuma praśna karanevāloṃmeṃ atyanta śreṣṭha ho, isalie aura bhī dhanya ho, āja mahāpurāṇasambandhī praśna pachate hue tumane hama logoṃke cittako bahuta hī harṣita kiyā hai|||28|| he śreṇika, śreṣṭha akṣaroṃse sahita jisa purāṇako hama loga pachanā cāhate the use hī tumane pūchā hai| dekho, yaha kaisā acchā sambandha milā hai ||29|| jānanekī icchā prakaṭa karanā praśna kahalātā hai| āpane apane praśnameṃ dharmakā svarūpa jānanā cāhā hai| so he śreṇika, dharmakā svarūpa jānanekī icchā karate hue āpane sāre saṃsārako jānanā cāhā hai arthāt dharmakā svarūpa jānanekī icchāse āpane akhila saṃsārake svarūpako jānanekī icchā prakaṭa kī hai ||30|| he śreṇika, dekho, yaha dharma eka vṛkṣa hai| artha

32
ādipurāṇam dharmādarthaśca kāmaśca svargaścetyavigānataḥ'| dharmaḥ kāmārthayoḥ sūtirityāyuṣman vinicinu ||32|| dharmārthī sarvakāmārthī dharmārthī dhanasaulyavāna dharmo hi mūlaṃ sarvāsāṃ dhanardisukhasaṃpradām ||33|| dharmaḥ kāmadudhā dhenurdharmacintāmaṇimahān | dharmaḥ kalpataruḥ stheyān dharmo hi nidhirakṣayaḥ ||3|| paśya dharmasya māhātmyaṃ yo'pāyātparirakṣati | yatra sthitaṃ naraṃ dūrācā tikrāmanti devatāḥ ||35|| "vicāranṛpalokātmadivyapratyayato'pi ca | dhīman dharmasya māhātmyaṃ nirvicāramavehi moḥ ||36|| sa dharmo vinipātebhyo yasmāt saṃdhārayevaram | dhatte cābhyudayasthāne nirapāyasulodaye ||37|| saca dharmaḥ purāṇārthaḥ purāṇaṃ panavā viduḥ | kṣetraṃ kālama tīrtha ca sarasastadviceṣṭitam ||38|| kṣetraṃ trailokyavinyāsaḥ kālastrakālpavistaraḥ | muktyupāyo bhavettīrtha puruṣāstaniṣeviṇaḥ ||39|| nyāsyamācaritaṃ teṣāṃ caritaṃ duritacchidām | iti kṛtsnaḥ purāṇārthaḥ praśne saṃbhāvitastvayā ||40||
maho prasanagammīraḥ praśno'yaṃ viśvagocaraḥ| kṣetrakṣetrajñasanmārgakākhasamaritā ||4|| usakā phala hai aura kāma usake phaloṃkā rasa hai| dharma, artha aura kāma ina tīnoṃko trivarga kahate haiṃ, isa trivargako prāptikā mūla kāraṇa dharmakā sunanā hai ||31|| he āyuṣman , tuma yaha niścaya karo ki dharmase hī artha, kāma, svargakī prāpti hotī hai| sacamuca vaha dharma hī artha aura kāmakā utpattisthāna hai ||32|| jo dharmakī icchā rakhatā hai vaha samasta iṣṭa padārthoṃko icchā rakhatā hai| dharmakī icchā rakhanevālā manuṣya hī dhanī aura sukhī hotā hai kyoṃki dhana, ṛddhi, sukhanaji ādi sabakā mala kāraṇa eka dhame hīhai||33|| manacāhī vastaoṃko deneke lie dhameṃ hī kāmadhenu hai, dharma hī mahāna cintāmaṇi hai, dharma hī sthira rahanevālā kalpavṛkṣa hai aura dharma hī avināśī nidhi hai ||34|| he śreṇika, dekho dharmakā kaisā māhātmya hai, jo puruṣa dharma meṃ sthira rahatā hai-nirmala bhāvoṃse dharmakā ācaraṇa karatā hai vaha use aneka saṃkaṭoṃse bacātā hai| tathā devatā bhī usapara ākramaṇa nahīṃ kara sakate, dūra-dūra hī rahate haiṃ ||35|| he buddhiman , vicāra, rājanīti, lokaprasiddhi, ātmānubhava aura uttama jñānādikī prāptise bhī dharmakā acintya māhātmya jānā jātā hai| bhāvārtha-dravyoṃkī ananta śaktiyoṃkā vicāra, rāja-sammāna, lokaprasiddhi, ātmānubhava aura avadhi manaḥparyaya ādi śāna ina sabakī prāpti dharmase hī hotī hai| ataḥ ina saba bātoṃko dekhakara dharmakā alaukika māhātmya jānanā cāhie ||36|| yaha dharma naraka nigoda ādike duḥkhoṃse isa jīvakī rakṣā karatā hai aura avināśī sukhase yukta mokṣasthānameṃ ise pahu~cā detā hai isalie ise dharma kahate haiṃ ||37|| jo purāṇakā artha hai vahī dharma hai, munijana purāṇako pā~ca prakārakā mānate haiṃ-kṣetra, kāla, tīrtha, satpuruṣa aura unakī ceṣṭāe~ ||38|| ūrdhva, madhya aura pātālarūpa tīna lokoṃkī jo racanā hai use kṣetra kahate haiṃ | bhūta, bhavidhyat aura vartamānarūpa tīna kāloṃkājo vistāra hai use kāla kahate haiṃ| mokṣaprāptike upāyabhūta samyagdarśana, samyagjñāna aura samyakcāritrako tīrtha kahate haiṃ| isa tīrthako sevana karanevāle śalākāpuruṣa satpuruṣa kahalāte haiṃ aura pāpoṃko naṣṭa karanevāle una satpuruṣoṃke nyāyopeta ācaraṇako unakī ceṣṭāe~ athavā kriyāe~ kahate haiṃ| he śreṇika, tumane purāṇake isa sampūrṇa arthako apane praśnameṃ samāviṣṭa kara diyā hai ||39-40|| aho śreṇika, tumhārā yaha praśna sarala honepara bhī gambhīra hai, saba tattvoṃse bharā huā hai tathā kṣetra, kṣetrako jānanevālā ātmā,

he svāmin , yadyapi pratyakṣa jñānake dhāraka baḍa़e-baḍa़e muni bhī apane jñāna-dvārā āpake abhyudayako nahīṃ jāna sake haiṃ tathāpi hama loga pratyakṣa stotroṃke dvārā āpakī stuti karaneke lie tatpara hue haiṃ so yaha eka āścaryakī hī bāta hai ||47|| he ṛṣe, āpa caudaha mahāvidyā (caudaha pūrva ) rūpī sāgarake pāragāmī haiṃ ataḥ hama loga mātra bhaktise prerita hokara hī āpakī stuti karanā cāhate haiṃ ||48|| he bhagavan , āpa bhavya jīvoṃko mokṣasthānakī prāpti karānevāle haiṃ, āpakī candramāke samāna ujjvala kīrti phaharātī huī patākāke samāna śobhāyamāna ho rahī hai ||49|| deva, cāroṃ ora phaile hue samudrako jisane apanā ālabāla (kyārī) banāyā hai aisī baḍha़tī huī āpakī yaha kīrtirūpī latā isa samaya sanāḍa़īrūpī vṛkṣake agrabhāgapara ākramaṇa kara rahī hai-usapara ārūḍha़ huā cāhatī hai ||50|| he nātha, baḍa़e-baḍa़e muni bhī yaha mānate haiṃ ki āpa yogiyoṃmeṃ mahāyogī haiṃ, prasiddha haiṃ, asaṃkhyāta guṇoṃke dhāraka haiṃ tathā saṃghake adhipati-gaṇadhara haiṃ ||5||

ādipurāṇam gotamā 'gau prakṛṣṭā syāt sā ca sarvajñamāratī| tāṃ vessi tāmadhīṣe ca tvamato gautamo mataḥ ||52|| gotamādāgato devaḥ svargāprād gautamo mataḥ | tena proktamadhīyānastvaṃ cāsau gautamaśrutiḥ ||53|| indreṇa prāptapūjarbuirindrabhūtistvamiṣyase | sākṣāt sarvajñaputrasvamālasaṃjñānakaṇṭhikaḥ ||54|| caturmiścāmalabarbodhairabuddhastvaṃ jagad yataḥ | prajñāpāramitaṃ buddhaṃ tvāṃ nirāhurato budhāḥ ||55|| pāratamaḥ paraṃ jyotistvāmadṛṣṭvā durāsadam | jyotirmayaḥ pradīpo'si tvaṃ tasyābhiprakāśanāt ||56|| śrutadevyāhitastraiṇaprayatnā bodhadīpikā| tavaiṣā prajvalatyuccai?tayantī jagadgṛham ||57|| tava vākprakaro divyo vidhunvan jagatāṃ tamaḥ | prakāśayati sanmārga rakheriva karoskaraḥ ||5|| tava lokātigā prajñā vidyānāṃ pārahaśvarī | śrutaskandhamahāsindhoramajada yānapātratām ||5|| svayāvatāritā tuṅgānmahāvīrahimācalāt | śrutāmarasaritpuṇyā nirdhanānākhilaṃ rajaḥ ||60|| pratyakṣaśca parokṣaśca dvidhā te jñānaparyayaḥ | kevalaṃ kevalinyekastatastvaṃ śrutakevalī ||6||
utkṛṣṭa vāṇīko gautama kahate haiṃ aura vaha utkṛṣṭa vāṇī sarvajña-tīrthakarakī divya dhvani hī ho sakatī hai use āpa jānate haiṃ athavā usakā adhyayana karate haiṃ isalie āpa gautama māne gaye haiṃ arthāt āpakā yaha nāma sārthaka hai (śreṣṭhā gauḥ,gotamā, tāmadhīte veda vāgautamaḥ 'tadadhīte vedavā' ityaṇapratyayaḥ) ||52|| athavā yoṃ samajhie ki bhagavān vardhamāna svāmī, gotama arthāt uttama solahaveṃ svargase avatīrṇa hue haiṃ isalie vardhamāna svāmīko gautama kahate haiṃ ina gautama arthāt vardhamāna svāmī-dvārā kahī huī divyadhvaniko āpa paḍha़te haiṃ, jānate haiṃ, isalie loga āpako gautama kahate haiṃ | (gotamādāgataḥ gautamaḥ 'tata āgataḥ' ityaṇa , gautamena proktamiti gautamam, gautamam adhīte veda vā gautamaḥ) ||53|| āpane indrake dvārā kī huī arcārūpī vibhūtiko prāpta kiyā hai isalie āpa indrabhūti kahalāte haiṃ| tathā āpako samyagjñānarūpī kaṇṭhābharaṇa prāpta huā hai ataḥ āpa sarvajñadeva śrī vardhamāna svāmīke sākṣāt putrake samāna haiṃ ||54|| he deva, āpane apane cāra nirmala jñānoṃke dvārā samasta saṃsārako jāna liyā hai tathā āpa buddhike pārako prāpta hue haiṃ isalie vidvān loga āpako buddha kahate haiṃ ||55|| he deva, āpako binā dekhe ajñānāndhakārase pare rahanevālī kevalajñānarūpī utkṛṣṭa jyotikā prāpta honā atyanta kaṭhina hai, āpa usa jyotike prakāśa honese jyotisvarūpa anokhe dīpaka haiṃ ||56|| he svāmin , śruta devatāke dvārā strīrūpako dhāraṇa karanevālī āpakī samyagjñānarūpī dīpikā jagatarūpī gharako prakāśita karatī huī atyanta śobhāyamāna ho rahī hai ||57|| āpake divya vacanoṃkā samūha logoṃke mithyātva rūpī andhakārako naṣṭa karatā huā sūryako kiraṇoṃke samūhake samāna samīcīna mārgakā prakāśa karatā hai ||58|| he deva, āpakī yaha prajñā lokameṃ sabase caḍha़ī-baḍha़ī hai, samasta vidyāoṃmeṃ pāraṃgata hai aura dvādaśāṃgarūpī samudrameṃ jahājapaneko prāpta hai-arthāt jahājakā kāma detī hai ||59|| he deva, āpane atyanta ū~ce vardhamāna svāmīrūpa himālayase usa śrutajñānarūpī gaṅgā nadīkā avataraṇa karāyā hai jo ki svayaṃ isalie āpa śrutakevalī

dvitīya parva pāretamaḥ paraṃdhāma praveṣṭumanaso vayam | taddvāroddhāṭanaṃ bīja svāmupāsya labhemahi ||3|| brahmoyā nikhilā 'vidyāstvaṃ hi brahmasuto muniḥ | paraṃ brahma tvadāyattamato brahmavido viduḥ ||63|| munayo vātaraśanāḥ padamūrdhva "vidhitsavaḥ | tvāṃ mūrddhavandino bhūtvā tadupāyamupāsate ||6|| mahāyogin namastubhyaṃ mahāprajña namo'stu te | namo mahātmane tubhyaṃ namaḥ stātte maharddhaye ||65|| namo'vadhijuṣe tubhyaṃ namo deśāvadhisviṣe | paramāvadhaye tubhyaṃ namaḥ sarvāvadhispṛśe ||66|| koṣṭabuddhe namastubhyaṃ namaste 'bojabuddhaye | padānusārin "saṃminnaśrotastubhyaṃ namo namaḥ ||67||

śārdūlavikrīḍitam
ityācārya paramparīṇamamalaṃ puṇyaṃ purāṇaṃ purā kalpe yadbhagavānuvāca vṛṣabhaścakrādibhatre jinaḥ |
tadvaḥ pāpakalaṅkapaṅkamakhilaṃ prakṣālya śuddhiṃ parāṃ deyāt puṇyavacojalaṃ paramidaṃ tīrthaṃ jagatpāvanam || 162|| ityārṣe bhagavajjinasenācāryapraṇīte triṣaṣṭilakṣaṇa mahāpurāṇasaṃ he kathāmukhavarṇanaṃ nāma dvitīyaṃ parva ||2||
hai vaha purāṇa hī śreṣṭha aura prāmāṇika hai isake sivāya aura saba purāṇa purāṇābhāsa haiṃ unheṃ kevala vāṇīke doṣamātra jānanā cāhie || 154 || jaba ki pacaparameṣṭhiyoṃkā nāma lenā hī jīvoṃko pavitra kara detā hai taba bāra-bāra unakī kathārūpa amṛta kā pāna karanā to kahanā hī kyā hai ? vaha to avaśya hī jīvoṃko pavitra kara detā hai-karmamalase rahita kara detā hai || 155 || jaba yaha bāta hai to śraddhālu bhavya jīvoṃko puṇyarūpī ratnoṃse bhare hue isa purāṇarūpī ' samudra meṃ avaśya hī avagāhana karanā cāhie || 156 || ūpara jisa purāṇakā lakṣaṇa kahā hai aba yahā~ kramase usīko kaheṃge aura usameṃ bhī sabase pahale bhagavān vṛṣabhanātha ke purāṇakī kārikā kaheṃge ||157|| śrī vṛṣabhanāthake purāṇa meṃ kālakā varṇana, kulakaroṃko utpatti, vaṃśoṃkā nikalanā, bhagavānkā sāmrājya, arahanta avasthā, nirvāṇa aura yugakā viccheda honā ye mahādhikāra haiṃ | anya purāṇoṃmeṃ jo adhikāra hoṃge ve samayānusāra batāye jāyeṃge || 158 - 159 ||
isa kathā upodghāta hai, aba āge isa kathākī pīṭhikā, kālāvatāra aura kulakaroṃkī sthiti kaheṃge ||160|| isa prakāra gautama svāmīke kahanepara bhaktise namra huī vaha muniyoṃkī samasta sabhā purāṇa sunane kī icchāse śreṇika mahārājake sātha sāvadhāna ho gayī, so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki aisā kauna buddhimāna hogā jo ki āpta puruṣoṃke hitakārī vacanoṃkā anādara kare ||161|| isa prakāra jo ācārya-paramparāse prāpta huā hai, nirdoṣa hai, puṇyarūpa hai aura yuga ādimeṃ bharata cakravartī ke lie bhagavān vṛṣabhadevake dvārā kahā gayā thā, aisā yaha jagatko pavitra karanevālā utkṛṣṭa tīrthasvarūpa purāṇarūpī pavitra jala tuma logoṃke samasta pāpa kalaṃkarūpī kīcaḍa़ko dhokara tumheṃ parama śuddhi pradāna kare || 162 ||
isa prakāra ārṣa nāmase prasiddha, śrībhagavajjinasenācārya viracita triṣaṣṭilakṣaṇa mahāpurāṇa ke saṃgrahameṃ ‘kathāmukhavarṇana' nāmaka dvitīya parva samāpta huā || 2 ||

ādipurāṇam teṣāṃ svabhāvasiddhaskhe koke'pyetat prasajyate | cinirmātṛvad viśva svataḥsiddhimavāpnurāt ||20|| sṛjeda vināpi sāmanayā svatantraḥ prabhurichayā| itīcchāmātramevaitat kaḥ śrādhyādayaktikam ||21|| kṛtārthasya vinirmitsā kathamevāsya yujyate | akṛtārtho'pi na sraṣṭuṃ viśvamīpṭe kulālavat ||22|| mamatoṃ niṣkriyo byāpī kathameṣa jagat sṛjet | na sisṛkṣāpi tasyāsti vikriyārahitātmanaḥ ||23|| tathāpyasya jagatsageṃ phalaṃ kimapi mṛgyatām | niṣṭhitārthasya dharmādipuruṣārtheṣvanarthinaḥ ||24|| svabhāvato vinaivārthāt sṛjato'narthasaṃgatiḥ | krīḍevaṃ kāpi cedasya durantā mohasantatiḥ ||25||
yadi yaha kaho ki vaha kāraṇa-sāmagrī svabhāvase hī-apane-āpa hī bana jātī hai, use īśvarane nahīṃ banāyā hai to yaha bāta lokameṃ bhī lāgū ho sakatī hai-mānanā cāhie ki loka bhī svataḥ siddha hai use kisīne nahīṃ banāyā| isake atirikta eka bāta yaha bhī vicāraṇīya hai ki usa īśvarako kisane banāyā ? yadi use kisīne banāyā hai taba to ūpara likhe anusāra anavasthā doṣa ātā hai aura yadi vaha svataḥ siddha hai-use kisīne bhī nahīṃ banāyā hai to yaha loka bhī svataḥ siddha ho sakatā hai-apane āpa bana sakatā hai ||20|| yadi yaha kaho ki vaha īśvara svatantra hai tathā sṛṣṭi banānemeṃ samartha hai isalie sāmagroke binā hī icchā mātrase lokako banā letā hai to āpakī yaha icchā mātra hai| isa yuktiśūnya kathanapara bhalā kauna buddhimān manuṣya viśvāsa karegā ? ||21|| eka bāta yaha bhī vicāra karane yogya hai ki yadi vaha īśvara kṛtakṛtya hai-saba kārya pūrṇa kara kara cukā hai-use aba koī kārya karanā bākī nahīṃ raha gayā hai to use sṛṣṭi utpanna karaneko icchā hī kaise hogī ? kyoṃki kṛtakṛtya puruṣako kisī prakārakī icchā nahīṃ hotī| yadi yaha kaho ki vaha akṛtakṛtya hai to phira vaha lokako banāneke lie samartha nahīṃ ho sakatā| jisa prakāra. akṛtakṛtya kumhāra lokako nahīṃ banā sakatā ||22||
eka bāta yaha bhī hai ki āpakā mānā huā īśvara amūrtika hai, niṣkriya hai, vyāpī hai aura vikārarahita hai so aisā īśvara kabhī bhī lokako nahīṃ banā sakatā kyoṃki yaha ūpara likha āye haiṃ ki amūrtika īśvarase mūrtika padārthoṃ kī racanā nahīṃ ho sakatī| kisī kāryako karaneke lie hasta-pādādike saṃcālana rūpa koī-na-koī kriyā avaśya karanī paḍa़tī hai parantu āpane to īśvarako niṣkriya mānā hai isalie vaha lokako nahīṃ banā sakatā| yadi sakriya māno to vaha asaṃbhava hai kyoṃki kriyā usīke ho sakatī hai jisake ki adhiṣṭhānase kucha kṣetra bākī bacā ho parantu āpakā īśvara to sarvatra vyāpī hai vaha kriyā kisa prakāra kara sakegā ? isake sivāya īśvarako sṛṣṭi racanekī icchā bhī nahīṃ ho sakatī kyoṃki āpane īśvarako nirvikāra mānā hai| jisakī ātmāmeṃ rāga-dveṣa ādi vikāra nahīṃ hai usake icchākā utpanna honā asambhava hai ||23|| jaba ki īśvara kṛtakṛtya hai tathā dharma, artha, kāma, mokṣameṃ kisīkī cāha nahīṃ rakhatā taba sṛṣṭi ke banāne meṃ ise kyā phala milegā ? isa bātakā bhī to vicāra karanā cāhie, kyoṃki binā prayojana kevala svabhāvase hī sṛṣṭikī racanā karatā hai to usakī vaha racanā nirarthaka siddha hotī hai | yadi yaha kaho ki usakī yaha krīḍa़ā hī hai, krīḍā mātrase hī jagatko banātā hai taba to duḥkhake sātha kahanā paḍa़egā ki āpakā īśvara baḍa़ā mohī hai, baḍa़ā ajñānī hai jo ki bālakoṃke samāna niṣprayojana kārya karatā hai ||24-25||

caturtha parva karmāpekṣaḥ śarīrādidehināṃ ghaṭayed yadi | 'nanvevamīśvaro na syāt pāratantryāt kuvindavat ||26|| nimittamātramiṣṭaścet kāyeṃ karmādihetuke | siddhopasthāyyasau hanta poṣyate kimakāraṇam ||27|| vatsalaḥ prāṇināmekaḥ sṛjannanujighṛkṣayā | nanu saukhyamayīṃ sṛṣṭiṃ vidadhyādanupaplutām ||28|| sṛṣṭiprayāsavaiyathyaṃ sarjane jagataḥ sataḥ | nātyantamasata: sargo yukto vyomāravindavat ||29|| nodāsīnaḥ sṛjenmuktaḥ saṃsārī nāpyanīśvaraḥ | sṛṣṭivādāvatāro'ya tataśca na kutaśca na ||30|| mahānadharmayogo'sya sṛṣṭvā saṃharataḥ prajāḥ| duṣṭanigrahabuddhayā ced varaṃ daityādyasarjanam ||31|| buddhimaddhetusānnidhye tanvādyutpattumarhati |' viśiṣṭasaṃniveśādipratītenagarādivat ||32||
yadi yaha kaho ki īśvara jīvoṃke śarīrādika unake karmoṃke anusāra hī banātā hai arthāt jo jaisā karma karatā hai usake vaise hī śarīrādikī racanā karatā hai to yaha kahanā bhī ṭhīka nahīṃ hai kyoṃki isa prakāra mānanese āpakā īśvara īśvara hī nahīṃ ṭhaharatā| usakā kāraṇa yaha hai ki vaha kamoṃkī apekṣā karanese julāhekī taraha paratantra ho jāyegā aura paratantra honese īśvara nahīṃ raha sakegā, kyoṃki jisa prakāra julāhā sūta tathā anya upakaraṇoṃke paratantra hotā hai tathā paratantra honese īśvara nahīṃ kahalātā isī prakāra āpakā īśvara bhī karmoke paratantra hai tathā paratantra honese īśvara nahīṃ kahalā sakatā| iśvara to savatantrasvatantra huā karatā haiṃ ||26|| yāda yaha kaho ki jīvake ke anusāra sukha-duḥkhādi kārya apane-āpa hote rahate haiṃ īśvara unameṃ nimitta mānā ho jātā hai to bhī āpakā yaha kahanā ṭhīka nahīṃ hai, kyoṃki jaba sukha-duḥkhādi kārya karmoke anusāra apane-āpa siddha ho jāte haiṃ taba kheda hai ki āpa vyartha hī īśvarakī puṣṭi karate haiṃ ||27|| kadācit yaha kahā jāye ki īśvara baḍa़ā premī hai-dayālu hai isalie vaha jīvoṃkā upakāra karaneke lie hī sṛṣṭikī racanā karatā hai to phira use isa samasta sṛṣṭiko sukharūpa tathā upadravarahita hī banānā cāhie thā| dayālu hokara bhī sṛṣṭike bahubhāgako duḥkhī kyoṃ banātā hai ? |28|| eka bāta yaha bhī hai ki sṛṣṭike pahale jagat thā yā nahīṃ ? yadi thā to phira svataḥ siddha vastuke racanemeṃ usane vyartha pariśrama kyoṃ kiyā ? aura yadi nahīṃ thā to usakī vaha racanā kyā karegā ? ādipurāṇam daśayojanavistīrṇa-śreṇīdvayasamāśrayān | yo dhatte khecarāvāsān 'suraveśmāpahāsinaḥ ||85|| 'khecarījanasaṃcārasaṃkrāntapadayāvakaiḥ | raktāmbujopahāraśrīyaṃtra nityaṃ vitanyate ||86|| abhedyaśaktirakṣayyaḥ 'siddhavicairupāsinaḥ | dadhadātyantikī śuddhiṃ siddhātmeva vibhāti yaḥ ||8|| yo'nādikālasaṃbandhiśuddhiśaktisamanvayāt | bhanyātmanirviśeṣo'pi dīkṣāyogaparāṅmukhaḥ ||8|| vidyādharaiḥ sadārādhyo nirmalātmā "sanātanaḥ| 'suniścitapramāṇo yo dhatte jaināgamasthitim ||89|| bhajantyekākino nityaṃ ''vītasaṃsāramītayaḥ | pravṛddhanakharā" dhīrā yaṃ siṃhā iva cāraṇāḥ ||10||

tadanantara, kisī dina rājā mahābalakī janmagā~ṭhakā utsava ho rahā thā | vaha utsava maṃgalagīta, vāditra tathā nṛtya ādike ārambhase bharā huā thā ||1|| usa samaya vidyādharoṃke adhipati rājā mahābala siṃhāsanapara baiṭhe hue the| aneka vārāṃganāe~ unapara kṣīrasamudrake samāna śvetavarṇa cāmara ḍhora rahī thīṃ ||2|| unake samīpa khaḍa़ī huī ve taruṇa striyā~ aisī mālūma hotī thīṃ māno kāmadevarūpī vṛkṣakī maṃjariyā~ hī hoṃ, athavā saundaryarūpī sāgarakī taraṃgeṃ hī hoṃ athavā sundaratākī kalikāe~ hī hoṃ ||3|| apane-apane viśāla vakṣaḥsthaloṃse samīpake pradeśako ācchādita karanevāle tathā mukuṭoṃse śobhāyamāna aneka vidyādhara rājā mahābalako gherakara baiṭhe hue the| unake bīcameṃ baiṭhe hue mahāvala aise śobhāyamāna ho rahe the māno aneka parvatoṃse ghirā huā yā unake bīca meṃ sthita sumeru parvata ho ho| ||4|| unake vakṣaḥsthalapara candramāke samāna ujjvala kāntikā dhāraka-śveta hāra paḍa़ā huā thā jo ki himavat parvatake śikharapara paḍa़te hue jharaneke samāna śobhāyamāna ho rahā thā ||5|| jisa prakāra vistṛta ākāśameṃ jalakākake idhara-udhara calatī huī haṃsoṃkī paṃkti śobhāyamāna hotī hai usī prakāra rājā mahābalake vistīrṇa vakṣaḥsthalapara indranīlamaṇise sahita motiyoṃkī kaṇṭhī śobhāyamāna ho rahī thī||6|| usa samaya mantrī, senāpati, purohita, seṭha tathā anya adhikārī loga rājā mahābalako gherakara baiṭhe hue the ||7|| ve rājā kisīke sātha ha~sakara, kisīke sātha sambhāṣaṇa kara, kisīko sthāna dekara, kisīko dāna dekara, kisīkā sammāna kara aura kisīkī ora ādarasahita dekhakara una samasta sabhāsadoṃko santuṣṭa kara rahe the ||8|| ve mahābala saṃgīta ādi aneka kalāāṃke jānakāra vidvān puruṣoṃkī goṣṭhokā bāra-bāra anubhava karate jāte the| tathā śrotāoṃke samakṣa kalāvid puruṣa parasparameṃ jo spardhā karate the use bhī dekhate jāte the| isī bīca meṃ sāmantoṃ-dvārā bheje hue dūtoṃko dvārapāloṃke hātha bulavākara unakā bāra-bāra yathāyogya

pañcamaṃ parva tasmād dharmaphalaṃ śāsvā sarva rājyādilakṣaṇam | tadarthinā mahābhāga dharme kāryā matiḥ sthirā ||24|| dhīmanimāṃ calāṃ lakṣmī śāśvatīṃ kartumicchatā | svayā dharmo'numantavyaḥ so'nuṣṭheyaśca śaktitaḥ ||25|| ityuktvātha svayaṃbuddhe svāmiśreyo'nubandhini | dharnāmarthya yaśasyaṃ ca vaco 'viratimīthuṣi ||26|| tatastadvacanaṃ sohumaśako durmatoddhataḥ | dvitīyaḥ sacivo vācamityuvāca mahāmatiḥ ||27|| bhūtavādamathālamya sa laukāyatikī śrutim | prastuvajīvatasvasya dūṣaṇe matimātanot ||28|| sati dharmiṇi dharmasya ghaṭate deva cintanam | sa eva tāvāsyāsmā kuto dharmaphalaṃ majet ||29|| pṛthivyappavanāgnīnāṃ saṃghātādiha cetanā | prādurbhavati macāṅgasaṃgamānmadaśaktivat ||30|| tato na cetanā kāyatastrāt pṛthagihāsti naḥ | tasyāstavyatirekeṇānupalabdheḥ khapuṣpavat ||31|| 'tato na dharmaḥ pāpaṃ vā paralokaśca kasyacit | jalabubudavajīvā vilīyante tanukṣayāt ||32|| tasmād iṣṭasukhaṃ tyaktvā paralokasukhārthinaḥ | vyarthakleśā bhavantyete lokadvayasukhāccyutāḥ ||33|| tadeṣāṃ paralokārthī samīhā kroṣṭu rāmiṣam | tyaktvā mukhāgataṃ mohān mīnāśotpatanāyate ||34||
karanā ye saba sanātana ( anādikālase cale āye) dharma kahalāte haiṃ || 23 || isalie he mahābhāga, rājya ādi samasta vibhūtiko dharmakā phala jānakara usake abhilāṣī puruṣoṃko apanī baddhi hameśā dharmameṃ sthira rakhanī cāhie ||24|| he badimana . yadi āpa isa caṃcala lakṣmīko sthira karanā cāhate haiṃ to āpako yaha ahiṃsādi rūpa dharma mānanā cāhie tathā śaktike anusāra usakā pālana bhī karanā cāhie ||25|| isa prakāra svāmīkā kalyāṇa cāhanevālā svayaṃbuddha mantrī jaba dharmase sahita, arthase bhare hue aura yaśako baḍha़ānevāle vacana kahakara cupa ho rahā taba usake vacanoṃko sunaneke lie asamartha mahāmati nāmakā dūsarā mithyādṛṣṭi mantrī nīce likhe anusāra bolā ||26-27| mahāmati mantrī, bhūtavādakā ālambana kara cārvāka matakā poṣaṇa karatā haā jīvatattvake viṣayameṃ daṣaṇa dene lagā ||28|| vaha bolā-he dharmīke rahate hue hī usake dharmakā vicāra karanā saṃgata (ṭhīka) hotā hai parantu ātmā nāmaka dharmīkā astitva siddha nahīṃ hai isalie dharmakā phala kaise ho sakatā hai ? ||29|| jisa prakāra mahuā, guḍa़, jala ādi padārthoke milā denese usameṃ mādaka śakti utpanna ho jātī hai uso prakāra pṛthivī, jala, vāyu aura agnike saṃyogase unameṃ cetanā utpanna hotī hai ||30|| isalie isa lokameṃ pṛthivī ādi tattvoṃse bane hue hamāre śarīrase pṛthak rahanevālā cetanā nāmakā koī padārtha nahīṃ hai kyoṃki śarīrase pṛthaka usakī upalabdhi nahīṃ dekhī jātī| saṃsārameṃ jo padārtha pratyakṣarūpase pṛthak siddha nahīṃ hote unakā astitva nahīṃ mānā jātā, jaise ki ākāśake phūlakā ||31|| jaba ki cetanāśakti nāmakā jīva pṛthak padārtha siddha nahīṃ hotā taba kisīke puṇya-pāpa aura paraloka ādi kaise siddha ho sakate haiṃ ? śarīrakā nāśa ho jānese ye jīva jalake babūleke samāna eka kṣaṇameṃ vilīna ho jāte haiṃ ||32|| isalie jo manuṣya pratyakṣakā sukha choḍa़kara paralokasambandhī sukha cāhate haiṃ ve donoṃ lokoṃke sukhase cyuta hokara vyartha hī kleśa uṭhāte haiṃ ||33|| ata eva vartamānake sakha choḍakara paralokake sakhoṃkī icchā karanā aisā hai jaise ki mukhameṃ āye hue māṃsako choḍa़kara mohavaśa kisī śṛgālakā machalīke

lie chalā~ga bharanā hai | arthāt jisa prakāra śṛgāla machalīkī āśāse mukhameṃ āye hue māṃsako choḍa़kara pachatātā hai usī prakāra paralokake sukhoṃkī āśāse vartamānake sukhoṃko choḍa़nevālā puruṣa bhī pachatātā hai 'ādhī choḍa़ ekako dhāvai, aisā ḍūbā thāha na pāvai ||34|| paralokake sukhoṃkī cāhase ṭhagāye hae jo markha mānava pratyakṣake bhāgoṃko choḍa dete haiṃ ve māno sāmane parosā huā bhojana choḍa़kara hātha hī cāṭate haiṃ arthāt parokṣa sukhakī āśāse vartamānake sukha choḍa़nā bhojana choḍa़kara hātha cāṭaneke tulya hai ||35|| ...
isa prakāra bhūtavādo mahāmati mantrī apane pakṣakī yuktiyā~ dekara jaba cupa ho rahā taba bāda karanekī khujalīse utpanna hue kucha hāsyako dhāraṇa karanevālā sambhinnamati nāmakā tīsarā mantrī bhī kevala vijñānavādakā āśraya lekara jīvakā abhāva siddha karatā huā nīce likhe anusāra apane matakī siddhi karane lagā ||36-37|| vaha bolā-he jīvavādina svayaṃbuddha, āpakā kahā huā jīva nāmakā koī pṛthak padārtha nahīṃ hai kyoṃki usakī pṛthak upalabdhi nahīṃ hotī | yaha samasta jagat vijñānamātra hai kyoṃki kṣaṇabhaṃgura hai| jo-jo kṣaṇabhaṃgura hote haiṃ ve saba jñānake vikāra hote haiṃ| yadi jñānake vikāra na hokara svatantra pṛthaka padārtha hote to ve nitya hote, parantu saṃsārameṃ koī nitya padārtha nahīṃ hai isalie ve saba jñānake vikāramātra haiṃ ||38|| vaha vijñāna niraṃśa hai-avāntara bhāgoṃse rahita hai, binā paramparā utpanna kiye hī usakā nāśa ho jātā hai aura vedya-vedaka tathā saṃvittirūpase bhinna prakāśita hotā hai| arthāt vaha svabhāvataḥ na to kisī anya jñānake dvārā jānā jātā hai
aura na kisīko jānatā hī hai, eka kṣaṇa rahakara samūla naṣṭa ho jātā hai ||39|| vaha jñāna naṣṭa honeke pahale hī apanī sāṃvṛtika santāna choḍa़ jātā hai jisase padārthoṃkā smaraṇa hotā rahatā hai| vaha santāna apane santānī jñānase bhinna nahīṃ hai ||40|| yahā~ praśna ho sakatā hai ki vijñānakī santāna pratisantāna māna lenese padārthakā smaraṇa to siddha ho jāyegā parantu pratyabhijñāna siddha nahīṃ ho sakegā| kyoṃki pratyabhijñānakī siddhike lie padārthako

ādipurāṇam śarīraṃ kimupādānaṃ saṃvidaḥ sahakāri vā | nopādānamupādeyād vijātīyatvadarśanāt ||62|| 'sahakārīti cediṣṭamupādānaṃ tu mṛgyatām | sūkṣmabhūtasamāhārastadupādānamityasat ||63|| tato bhūtamayād dehād vyatiminnaṃ svalakṣaṇam | jīvadravyamupādānaṃ caitanyasyeti gṛhyatām ||6|| etenaiva pratikṣipta madirāṅganidarśanam | madirāṅgeṣvavirodhinyā madaśakteviṃbhāvanāt ||65|| satyaṃ bhūtopasṛṣṭo'yaṃ bhūtavādī kuto'nyathā | bhūtamātramidaṃ viśvamabhūtaṃ pratipādayet ||66|| pṛthivyādiṣvanudbhūtaṃ caitanyaṃ pūrvamasti cet | nācetaneṣu caitanyaśaktervyaktamananvayāt ||67||. ādipurāṇam piturmānorivāpāyāt kuruvindo'ravindavat | parimlāmatanucchāyaḥ sa śocyāmagamad daśām ||116|| tathātraiva bhavavaṃśe vistīṇeṃ jaladhāviva | daṇḍo nāmnāmavat khendro daṇḍitārātimaṇḍalaḥ ||117|| maṇimālītyabhūttasmāt sūnumaṇirivāmbudhaiḥ | niyojya yauvarājye taṃ sveṣṭān bhogānabhuṅkta saḥ ||118|| bhuktvāpi suciraṃ bhogānnātṛpyad viṣayotsukaḥ | pratyutāsaktimamajat strīvastrābharaṇādiṣu ||119|| so'tyantaviṣayāsaktikṛtakauṭilya ceṣṭitaḥ | vabandha tīvrasaṃkleśāt tiraścāmāyurāta॑dhīḥ ||120|| jīvitānte sa dunimārsamāpūrya durmuteḥ | māṇḍāgāre nije mohān mahānajagaro'jani ||12|| sa jātismaratāṃ gatvā māṇḍāgārikavad bhṛśam | tatpraveśe nijaṃ sūnumanvamaṃsta na cāparam ||122|| anyecuravadhijñānalocanānmunipuṅgavāt | maṇimālī piturjñātvā taṃ vṛttāntamaśeṣataḥ ||123|| pitṛbhaktyā satanmarchāmapahartuṃ manāḥ sudhīḥ | 'śayoragra śanaiḥ sthitvā snehādā giramabhyadhāt||124|| pitaḥ patitavānasyāṃ kuyonāvadhunā svakam | viṣayāsajadoṣeṇa tamo dhanarddhiṣu ||125||
tato dhigidamatyantakaṭukaṃ viṣayāmiṣam | 'vamaitad durjaraṃ tāta kimpākaphalasanimam ||126|| rahita ho jātā hai athavā sūrya asta ho jānese jisa prakāra kamala murajhā jātā hai usī prakāra pitākī mṛtyuse kuruvindane apanā mu~ha nīcā kara liyā, usakā saba teja jātā rahā tathā sārā śarīra murajhā gayā-śithila ho gayā| isa prakāra vaha śocanīya avasthāko prāpta huā thā ||115-116||
he rājan , aba dūsarī kathā sunie-samudrake samāna vistīrṇa āpake isa vaṃśameṃ eka daṇḍa nāmakā vidyādhara ho gayā hai | vaha baḍa़ā pratāpī thā| usane apane samasta śatruoṃko daṇḍita kiyā thā ||117| jisa prakāra samudrase maṇi utpanna hotā hai usī prakāra usa daṇḍa vidyādharase bhī maṇimālī nāmakā putra utpanna huā| jaba vaha baḍa़ā huā taba rājā daṇḍane use yuvarājapadapara niyukta kara diyā aura āpa icchānusāra bhoga bhogane lagā||118|| vaha viṣayoṃ meṃ itanā adhika utsuka ho rahā thā ki cirakāla taka bhogoṃko bhogakara bhī tṛpta nahīṃ hotā thā balki strī, vastra tathā ābhūṣaṇa ādimeṃ pahalekī apekṣā adhika āsakta hotā jātā thā ||119|| atyanta viṣayāsaktike kāraṇa māyācārī ceṣṭāoṃko karanevāle usa ātadhyānī rājāne tīvra saṃkleśa bhāvoṃse tiryaśca āyukā bandha kiyā||120|| cū~ki marate samaya usakā ārtadhyāna nāmakā kudhyāna pūrṇatāko prāpta ho rahā thā, isalie kumaraṇase marakara vaha mohake udayase apane bhaṇḍārameṃ baḍa़ā bhārī ajagara huā ||121|| use jātismaraṇa bhī ho gayā thā isalie vaha bhaṇḍārīkī taraha bhaṇḍārameṃ kevala apane putrako hī praveśa karane detā thā anyako nahīṃ ||122|| eka dina atiśaya buddhimāna rājā maṇimālī kinhīṃ avadhijñānī munirājase pitāke ajagara hone ādikā samasta vṛttānta mālūma kara pitṛ-bhaktise unakā moha dūra karaneke lie bhaṇḍārameṃ gayā aura dhīrese ajagarake āge khaḍa़ā hokara snehayukta vacana kahane lagā ||123-124|| he pitā. tamane dhana. ṛddhi ādimeṃ atyanta mamatva aura viṣayoṃmeṃ atyanta āsakti kī thī isī doṣase tuma isa samaya isa kuyonimeṃ-sarpaparyāyameṃ ākara paḍa़e ho ||125|| yaha viṣayarūpī āmiṣa atyanta kaṭuka hai, durjara hai aura kiṃpāka (viṣaphala) phalake samāna hai isalie dhikkārake yogya hai| he pitājī, isa viṣayarūpī āmiṣako aba bhī choḍa़ do ||126||

svāmin, apane bhānaje va jaṃghako putrī deneke lie prasanna hoie | maiṃ āśā karatā hū~ ki merī prārthanā saphala ho aura yaha kumāra vañcajaṃgha hī usakā pati ho || 197|| he deva, dhana, savārī ādi vastue~ to mujhe āpase aneka bāra mila cukī haiṃ isalie unase kyā prayojana hai ? svadbhataḥ sukhamabhbeti lakṣmīstvantamaśnute | tvadbhaktirbhuktaye' puṃsāṃ muktaye yā 'sthavīyasī || 280|| to majanti maṭhayāstvāṃ manovākkāyaśuddhibhiḥ | phalārthibhirbhavān segyo vyaktaṃ kalpatarūyate || 281|| svayā pravarṣatā dharmavṛṣṭiṃ duṣkarmadharmataḥ | prodanyadbhavabhṛvārispṛhāṃ navaghanāyitam || 282|| svayā pradarśitaṃ mārgamāsevante hitaiṣiṇaḥ | bhāsvatā dyotitaṃ mārgamiva kāryārthino janāḥ || 283|| saṃsārocchedane bījaṃ tvayā tasvaṃ nidarśitam | prātrikāmutrikārthānāṃ yataḥ siddhirihāṅginām || 284|| lakṣmī sarvasvamujjhitvā sāmrājyaṃ prājyavaibhavam | svayā citramudūḍhāsa muktiśrīḥ spṛhayālunā || 285|| dayāvallīpariṣvako mahodarko mahokṣatiḥ | prārthitārthān prapuṣṇāti bhavān kalpadrumo yathā || 286|| svayā karmamahāśatrūnuccānucchetsu micchatā | dharmacakraṃ tapodhāraṃ pāṇaukṛtamasaṃbhramam" ||287||

prasīdati bhavatpādapajhe pamā prasīdati | vimukhe yāti baimukhyaṃ bhavanmābhyasthyamośam ||29|| prātihāryamayīṃ bhūtiṃ tvaṃ dadhāno'pyananyagām | vītarāgo mahāṃbāsi jagatyetajjināmṛtam ||29|| tavāyaṃ śiśiracchāyo māsyaśokatamahān | śokamāśritamaṇyānāṃ vidūra mapahastayan ||293|| puṣpavṛṣṭiṃ divo devāḥ kiranti svāṃ jināmitaḥ | parito merumutphullā yathā kalpamahīruhāḥ ||29|| divyabhāṣā tavāśeṣabhāṣābhedānukāriṇī| vikaroti manodhvāntamavācāmapi dehinām ||295|| prakīrṇakayugaṃ māti tvāṃ jinomayato dhutam | patavirasaṃvādi śaśākaranirmalam ||29|| cāmīkaravinirmāṇa harimitamāsanam | girīndraśikhara spardi rājate jinarāja te ||29|| jyotirmaṇḍalamutsarpat tavālaṃkurute tanum | mārtaṇḍamaṇḍaladveṣi vidhunvajagatāṃ tamaḥ ||29|| tavodghoṣayatīvoccaiḥ jagatāmekamartṛtām | dundumistanitaṃ mandramucarapathi vārmucām ||299|| tavāviṣkurute deva prābhavaṃ bhuvanātigam | vidhubimbapratispardi chantratritayamucchitam ||30||

krodhase jisakā phaṇa ūpara uṭhā huā hai aura jo bhayaṃkara viṣa ugala rahā hai aisā sarpa bhī āpake caraṇarūpī auṣadhake smaraṇase śīghra ho viṣarahita ho jātā hai ||307 || he deva, āpake caraṇoṃke atha tatrāvasaddīrgha sa kālaṃ cakrimandire | nityotsave mahābhogasaṃpadā sopabhogayā || 1 || śrīmatī stanasaṃsparśāt tanmukhābjavilokanāt | tasyāsīnmahatī prīti: premṇe vastviṣṭamāśritam ||2|| tanmukhābjād rasāmodā vāharātṛpan nṛpaḥ | madhuvrata ivāmbhojāt kāmasevā na tṛptaye ||3|| mukhendumasyāḥ so'paśyan nirnimeṣotkayā dṛśā | kāntimaddaśanajyotirjyotsnayā satatojjvalam ||4|| apāṅgavīkṣitai 'līlā smitaiśca kalabhāṣitaiḥ | mano babandha sā tasya "svasminnatyantabhāsuraiḥ ||5|| trivalīvīciramye'sau nāmikā varttaśomini | udare kṛśamadhyāyā reme nayā iva hade || 6 || nitambapuline tasyāḥ sa ciraṃ " dhṛtimātanot | kālīvihaṅgavirute" ramye haṃsayuvāyitaḥ || 7 || tarastanāṃśu "kamāhṛtya tatra vyāpārayan karam | madema iva so'māsīt padminyāḥ kuḍmalaṃ spṛśan ||8|| stanacakrāhvaye tasyāḥ śrīkhaṇḍadravakardame | uraḥsarasi reme'sau satkucāṃśukaśaivale ||9||
vivāha ho jāne ke bāda vajrajaṃghane, jahā~ nitya hī aneka utsava hote rahate the aise cakravartīke bhavanameṃ uttama-uttama bhogopabhoga sampadāoṃke dvārā bhogopabhogoṃkā anubhava karate hue dīrghakāla taka nivāsa kiyā thā || 1 || vahā~ śrīmatīke stanoṃkā sparśa karane tathā mukharūpī kamalake dekhane se use baḍa़ī prasannatā hotī thī so ṭhīka hī hai kyoṃki iṣṭa vastuke āśrayase sabhīko prasannatā hotī hai ||2|| jisa prakāra bhauṃrā kamalase rasa aura suvāsako grahaṇa karatā huā kabhī santuṣṭa nahīṃ hotā usī prakāra rājā vajrajaṃgha bhī śrīmatīke mukharūpī kamalase rasa aura suvāsako grahaṇa karatā huā kabhī santuṣṭa nahīṃ hotā thā | saca hai, kāmasevanase kabhī santoṣa nahīṃ hotā hai || 3 ||śrīmatīkā mukharūpī candramā camakīle dā~toṃkī kiraṇarūpī cā~danī se hameśā ujjvala rahatā thā isalie vajrajaṃdha use ṭimakārarahita lālasāpūrṇa dṛṣṭise dekhatā rahatā thā ||4|| śrīmatīne atyanta manohara kaṭākṣāvalokana, līlāsahita musakāna aura madhura bhāṣaṇoṃke dvārā usakā citta apane adhīna kara liyā thā ||5|| śrīmatīko kamara patalī thī aura udara kisī nadīke gahare kuṇḍake samāna thā | kyoṃki kuṇḍa jisa prakāra laharoṃse manohara hotā hai usī prakāra usakā udara bhī trivalise (nābhike nīce rahanevālī tīna rekhāoṃse) manohara thā aura kuṇḍa jisa prakāra āvartase śobhāyamāna hotā hai usī prakāra usakā udara bhī nābhirūpī āvartase śobhāyamāna thā | isa taraha jisakā madhya bhāga kṛśa hai aisī kisī nadīke kuṇḍake samāna śrīmatīke udara pradeśapara vaha vajrajaṃgha ramaṇa karatā thā ||6|| taruṇa haṃsake samāna vaha vajrajaṃgha, karadhanīrūpī pakṣiyoṃke śabdase śabdāyamāna usa śrīmatīke manohara nitambarūpī pulinapara cirakāla taka krīḍā karake santuṣṭa rahatā thā || 7|| stanoṃse bastra haṭākara unapara hātha pheratā huā vajaṃgha aisā śobhāyamāna hotā thā jaisā kamalinīke kuḍmala (bauḍa़ī) kā sparśa karatā huā madonmatta hāthī śobhāyamāna hotā hai || 8|| jo stanarūpī cakravāka pakṣiyoṃse sahita hai, candanadravarūpī

243 priyāganāsaṃsargād yadīha sukhamaṅginām | nanu pakṣimṛgādīnāṃ tirakṣāmastu tassukham ||17|| sunīmindramahe pūtivraṇībhūtakṛyonikām | avaśaṃ sevamānaḥ śvā sukhī cet sījuṣāṃ sukham ||18|| nimbadame yathotpannaḥ kīṭakastadrasopabhuk | madhuraṃ tadramaṃ vetti tathā viṣayiṇo'pyamī ||179|| saṃbhogajanitaṃ khedaṃ ślāvamānaḥ sukhāsthayo | tatraiva ratimāyānti mavāvaskarakīṭakāḥ ||18|| viṣayānubhavāt puṃsāṃ ratimātraṃ prajāyate | ratiśret sukhamāyātaṃ namva medhyādane'pi tat ||18|| yathāmī ratimāsāya viṣayānanubhujate | tathā śvaśūkarakulaṃ tadvatyaivārayamedhakam ||182|| gūthakṛmeryathā gūtharasasevā paraṃ sukham | tathaiva viṣayānīpsoḥ sukhaṃ jantoviṃgahitam ||183|| viṣayānanubhukṣānaḥ strīpradhānān savepathuḥ | śvasana prasvinasaṅgiḥ sukhī cedasukhīha kaḥ ||18||

ādipurāṇam tataḥ svābhāvikaṃ karma kṣayāt tatraśamādapi | yadāhādanamatat syāt sukhaṃ nānyajyapāśrayam ||18|| parivārarddhisāmagrathā sakhaṃ syāt kalpavāsinām | tadamāve'hamindrāṇāṃ kutastyamiti cet sukham ||187|| parivāraddhisatteva' kiṃ sukhaṃ kimu tadvatām | tatsevā sukhamityevamatra syād dvitayī gatiḥ ||18|| sāntaḥpuro dhanīddhaparivāro jvarī nṛpaḥ | sukhī syāt yadi.sanmātrād viṣayāt sukhamīpsitam ||189|| tatsevāsukhamityatra dattamavottaraṃ purā | satsevī tībramāyastaḥ kathaṃ vā sukhamāga bhavet ||19|| paśyaite viṣayāḥ svapnabhogāmā vipralammakāḥ | asthāyukāḥ kutastebhyaḥ sukhamādhiyāṃ nṛṇām ||19|| viṣayānarjayanneva tāvaduḥkhaṃ mahad bhavet | tadrakṣācintane bhūyo bhavedasyantamāsaṃdhīḥ ||192|| tad viyoge punaduḥkhamapāraṃ parivarttate | pūrvānubhūtaviṣayān smṛtvā smṛtvāvasīdataḥ ||15|| 'anāśitaṃbhavānetān viṣayāna dhigapayāyinaḥ yeṣāmāsevana jantona saṃtāpopaśāntaye ||19|| vatirivendhanaiḥ sindhoḥ srotobhiriva sāritaiḥ | na jātu viṣayairjantorupabhuktarvitṛṣṇatā ||195||
kṣāramambu yathā pītvā tṛpyatyatitarāṃ naraḥ | tathā viṣayasaṃmogaiḥ paraṃ saṃtarṣamṛcchati ||196|| kāraṇa viṣayoṃse ātmākā mohita ho jānā hī hai ||185|| isalie karmoke kṣayase athavā upaśamase jo svābhāvika āhvāda utpanna hotā hai vahī sukha hai | vaha sukha anya vastuoṃke āśrayase kabhī utpanna nahīṃ ho sakatā ||186|| aba kadācit yaha kaho ki svargomeṃ rahanevāle devoṃko parivāra tathā ṛddhi ādi sāmagrīse sukha hotā hai parantu ahamindroṃke vaha sāmagrī nahīṃ hai isalie usake abhāvameṃ unheṃ sukha kahā~se prāpta ho sakatā hai ? ||190|| dekho, ye viṣaya svapna meṃ prāpta hue bhogoṃke samāna asthāyī aura dhokhā denevāle haiṃ | isalie nirantara ārtadhyāna rūpa rahanevāle puruṣoṃko una viṣayoṃse sukha kaise prāpta ho sakatā hai ? bhāvārtha-pahale to viṣaya-sāmagrī icchānusāra sabako prāpta hotī nahīṃ hai isalie usakī prāptike lie nirantara ārtadhyāna karanā paḍa़tā hai aura dūsare prāpta hokara svapnameṃ dikhe hue bhogoṃke samāna śīghra hī naṣṭa ho jātī hai isalie nirantara iṣṭa viyogaja ārtadhyāna hotā rahatā hai | isa prakāra vicāra karanese mālūma hotā hai ki viṣaya-sāmagrī sukhakā kāraṇa nahīṃ hai ||191|| prathama to yaha jīva viṣayoṃke ikaṭṭhe karanemeṃ baḍa़e bhārī duḥkhako prāpta hotā hai aura phira ikaṭṭhe ho cukanepara unakī rakṣākī cintā karatā huā atyanta duḥkhī hotā hai ||192|| tadanantara ina viṣayoṃke naṣṭa ho jānese apāra duḥkha hotā hai kyoṃki pahale bhoge hue vipayoṃkā bāra-bāra smaraṇa karake yaha prāṇī bahuta hī duḥkhī hotā hai || 193 || jo atṛptikara haiṃ, vināśaśīla haiṃ aura jinakā sevana jīvoṃke santāpako dūra nahīṃ kara sakatā aise ina viṣayoṃko dhikāra hai| 194|| jisa prakāra iṃdhanase agnikī tṛṣṇā nahīṃ miṭatī aura nadiyoṃke pūrase samudrakī tṛṣṇā dūra nahīṃ hotī usī prakāra bhoge hue viṣayoṃse kabhī jīvoṃkī tṛṣṇā dūra nahīṃ hotī || 195 || jisa prakāra

ādipurāṇam saṣo sarasi saṃphulakumudorapalapaṅkaje | prāpaśyanayanāyāma darśayantāvivātmanaḥ ||112|| taratsarojakialkapiarodakamaikṣata | suvarṇadravasaṃpūrṇamiva digyaṃ sarovaram ||11|| kṣubhyantamabdhimudvelaṃ calakallolakāhalam | sādarśacchīkarairmoktumahāsamivodyatam ||11|| saiṃhamāsanamuttuṅgaṃ sphuranmaṇihiraṇmayam | sāpaśyanmerujasya baidagdhī dadhadūrjitām ||15|| nākālayaṃ vyalokiṣṭa parāyamaṇimāsuram | svasūnoḥ prasabāgāramiva devarupāhṛtam ||116|| phaṇīndrabhavanaṃ bhūmimuniyodgatamaikṣata | prāgasvavimānena spā kartumivodhatam ||117|| ravānāṃ rāśimutsarpadaṃśupallavitāmbaram | sā nidamyo parādegyā nidhāmamiva darśitam ||11|| jvalanāsuranidhūmavapurṣa viṣamāpim | pratāpamiva putrasya mūrtirūpaṃ nyacāvata ||19|| nyaśāmaya tujhā pujavaṃ rukmasacchavim | praviśanta vavaktrānaṃ svapnānte pīnakandharam ||120|| tataḥ "prābodhistūpaiyanaśiḥ pratyabuddha sā | bandinā maṅgalodgītoḥ śṛṇvatīti sumaṅgalāḥ ||121||
sukhaprabodhamādhātumetasyāḥ puṇyapāṭhakāḥ | tadā prapeṭurisyumigalānyaskhalaniraḥ ||122|| hue apane donoṃ stanakalaśa hī hoṃ ||11| nauveṃ svapnameṃ phūle hue kumuda aura kamaloṃse śobhāyamāna tālāba meṃ koḍa़ā karatī huī do machaliyā~ dekhīṃ| ve machaliyā~ aisī mālūma hotī thīṃ māno apane ( marudevīke ) netroṃkī lambāī hī dikhalā rahī hoṃ ||112|| dasaveṃ svapnameṃ usane eka sundara tālāba dekhā| usa tālābakā pānī tairate hue kamaloṃko keśarase pīlā-pīlā ho rahā thā jisase aisā mālūma hotā thā māno pighale hue suvarṇase hī bharā ho ||113|| gyārahaveṃ svapnameṃ usane jhabhita ho belā (taṭa) ko ullaghaṃna karatā huā samudra dekhā| usa samaya usa samudrameṃ uṭhatī huī laharoṃse kucha-kucha gambhīra śabda ho rahā thā aura jalake choṭe-choṭe kaṇa uḍa़kara usake cāroṃ ora paḍa़ rahe the jisase aisā mālūma hotā thā māno vaha aṭṭahāsa hī kara rahā ho ||114|| bārahaveṃ svapnameṃ usane eka ūṃcā siṃhāsana dekhā| vaha siṃhāsana suvarṇakā banā huā thā aura usameṃ aneka prakārake camakīle maṇi lage hue the jisase aisā mālūma hotā thā māno vaha meru parvatake śikharakī utkṛṣṭa śobhā hī dhāraṇa kara rahā ho ||115|| terahaveṃ svapna meṃ usane eka svargakā vimāna dekhā| vaha vimāna bahumūlya śreṣṭha ratnoṃse dedīpyamāna thā
aura aisā mālūma hotā thā māno devoṃke dvārā upahāra meṃ diyā huā, apane putrakā prasūtigṛha ( utpattisthāna) hī ho ||116|| caudahaveṃ svapnameṃ usane pṛthivīko bhedana kara ūpara āyā huā nāgendrakā bhavana dekhā| vaha bhavana aisā mālūma hotā thā māno pahale dikhe hue svargake vimānake sātha spardhā karaneke lie hī udyata huā ho ||117|| pandrahaveṃ svapnameṃ usane apanī uṭhatī huī kiraṇoṃse ākāśako pallavita karanevālī ranoṃkī rāśi dekhī| usa ranoṃkī rāśi. ko marudevīne aisā samajhā thā māno pṛthivī devīne use apanā khajānā hī dikhāyā ho ||118|| aura solahaveṃ svapnameṃ usane jalatī huī prakāśamāna tathā dhūmarahita agni dekhī| vaha agni aisī mālūma hotī thī māno honevāle putrakā mūrtidhārī pratāpa hī ho ||119|| isa prakāra solaha svapna dekhaneke bāda usane dekhā ki suvarṇake samāna pīlī kāntikā dhāraka aura ū~ce kandhoṃvālā eka ū~cā baila hamāre mukha-kamalameṃ praveśa kara rahā hai ||12||
tadanantara vaha bajate hue bājoṃkī dhvanise jagagayī aura bandījanoṃke nīce likhe hae maṃgalakāraka maṃgala-gīta sunane lagī ||121|| usa samaya marudevīko sukha-pūrvaka jagāneke lie, jinakī vāṇī atyanta spaṣṭa hai aise puṇya pāṭha karanevāle bandījana ucca svarase nīce likhe anusāra maṃgala

devi, idhara tālāboṃpara ye sārasa pakṣī manohara aura gambhīra śabda kara rahe haiṃ aura aise mālūma hote haiṃ māno maṃgala-pāṭha karate hue hama logoṃke sātha-sātha tumhārī stuti hī karanā cāhate hoṃ ||128| idhara gharako bāvaḍa़īmeṃ bhī kamalinīke kamalarūpī mukha praphullita ho gaye haiṃ aura unapara bhaure śabda kara rahe haiṃ jisase aisā mālūma hotā hai māno kamalinī ucca-svarase āpakā yaśa gā rahī ho ||129|| idhara rātrimeṃ parasparake virahase atiśaya santapta huā yaha cakavā-cakavīkā yugala aba tālābakī taraṃgoṃke sparśase kucha-kucha āśvāsana prāpta kara rahā hai ||130|| atiśaya dāha karanevālī candramākī kiraṇoṃse hṛdaya meṃ atyanta duḥkhī hue cakavā-cakavī aba mitra (sūrya) ke samāgamakī prārthanā kara rahe haiṃ, bhāvārtha-jaise jaba koī kisīke dvārāsatāyā jātā hai taba vaha apane mitrake sātha samāgamakī icchā karatā hai vaise hī cakavā-cakavī candramāke dvārā satāye jānepara mitra arthāt sūryake samāgamakī icchā kara rahe haiṃ ||131|| idhara bahuta jaldī honevāle striyoṃke viyogase utpanna hue duḥkhakī sūcanā karanevālī murgoṃkī teja āvāja kāmī puruṣoṃke manako santāpa pahu~cā rahī hai ||132|| śāntasvabhāvī candramākī komala kiraṇoṃse rātrikā jo andhakāra

ādipurāṇam tamaḥ śāvaramudbhiya karamānorudevyataḥ | senevāgresarī sandhyā sphuratyaṣānurāgiṇī ||134|| mitramaṇḍalamudgacchadidamātanute dvayam | vikāsamanjinīṣaṇḍa glāniṃ ca kumudākare ||135|| *vikasvaraṃ samālokya pabhinyāḥ parajānanam | sāsūryava parimlāniṃ prayātyeṣa kumadvatī||136|| puraḥ prasārayannucca: karānudyāti bhānumān | prācīdigajanāgarmāt tejīgarma havāmakaḥ ||137|| lakṣyate niṣadhotsaṃga mānurārakamaṇḍala: | pujīkṛta ivaikatra sāndhyo rāgaḥ sureśvaraḥ ||138|| tamo vidhūtamuddhataḥ cakravākapariklamaḥ | prabodhitābjinī māno janmanonmīlitaṃ jagat ||13|| samantādāpatatyeṣa pramāte śiśiro marut | kamalāmodamākarṣan praphullāiṭijanīvanāt ||14|| iti praspaṣṭa evāyaṃ prabodhasamayastava | devi mujādhunā talpaṃ śuci haṃsīva sakatam ||14|| "suprātamastu te nityaṃ kalyāṇaśatabhāgbhava | prācīvā prasādhīṣṭāḥ putraṃ trailokyadīpakam ||142|| svapnasaṃdarśanādeva prabuddhā prāktarāṃ punaḥ | prabodhitetyadarśat sā saṃpramodamayaṃ jagat ||143|| pravuddhā ca śubhasvapnadarśanānandanibharāt | tanu kaṇṭakitāmūhe sājinīva vikāsinī ||144||
naṣṭa nahīṃ ho sakā thā vaha aba teja kiraṇavāle sūryake udaya ke sammukha hote hī naṣṭa ho gayā hai ||133|| apanī kiraṇoṃka dvārā rātri sambandhī andhakārako naṣṭa karanevālā sūrya āge calakara udita hogā parantu usase anurāga (prema aura lālī) karanevālī sandhyā pahalese hī prakaṭa ho gayī hai aura aisī jāna paḍa़tī hai māno sūryarūpī senāpatikī āge calanevālī senā hī ho||134|| yaha udita hotā huā sūryamaṇḍala eka sātha do kāma karatā hai-eka to kamaliniyoṃke samūhameṃ vikāsako vistṛta karatā hai aura dūsarā kumudi niyoṃke samūhameṃ mlānatākā vistāra karatā hai ||135|| athavā kamalinīke kamalarūpī mukhako praphullita huā dekhakara yaha kumudinī māno īṣyāse mlānatāko prāpta ho rahī hai ||136|| yaha sūrya apane ū~ce kara arthāt kiraṇoṃko ( pakṣameṃ hāthoṃko) sāmane phailātā huā udita ho rahā hai jisase aisā mālūma hotā hai māno pūrva diśārūpo strīke garbhase koī tejasvī bālaka hī paidā ho rahā ho ||137|| niṣadha parvatake samīpa ārakta (lāla) maṇḍalakā dhāraka yaha sūrya aisā jāna paḍa़tā hai māno indroṃke dvārā ikaṭṭhā kiyā huā saba sandhyākā rāga (lālimā) hī ho ||138|| sūryakā udaya hote hī samasta andhakāra naṣṭa ho gayā, cakavā-cakaviyāṃkā kleśa dūra ho gayā, kamalinī vikasita ho gayī aura sārā jagat prakāśamāna ho gayā ||139|| aba prabhātake samaya phūle hue kamaliniyoṃke vanase kamaloṃkī sugandha grahaṇa karatā huā yaha śītala pavana saba ora baha rahā hai ||140|| isalie he deva, spaṣṭa hī yaha tere jāganekā samaya ā gayā hai| ataeva jisa prakāra haṃsinī bālūke ṭīleko choḍa़ detī hai usī prakāra tū bhī aba apanī nirmala śayyā choḍa़ ||141|| terā prabhāta sadā maṃgalamaya ho, tū saikaḍa़oṃ kalyāṇoṃko prāpta ho aura jisa prakāra pūrva diśā sūryako utpanna karatī hai usī prakāra tū bhī tīna lokako prakāśita karanevāle putrako utpanna kara ||142|| yadyapi vaha marudevī svapna dekhaneke kāraṇa, bandījanoṃke maṃgala-gānase bahuta pahale hī jāga cukī thī, tathāpi unhoṃne use phirase jagāyā| isa prakāra jāgṛta hokara usane samasta saṃsārako ānandamaya dekhā ||143|| śubha svapna dekhanese jise atyanta ānanda ho rahā hai aisī jāgī huī marudevī phūlī huī kamalinīke samāna kaṇṭakina arthāt romāṃcita (pakṣameṃ kā~ṭoṃse vyāpta) śarīra dhāraṇa kara rahī thī ||144||

263 tatastadarśanānandaṃ voḍhuṃ svāṅgeṣvivākṣī | kṛtamālanepathyā sā bheje patyurantikam ||145|| ucitena niyogena dṛṣṭvā sā nāmibhūbhujam | tasmai nṛpāsanasthāya sukhāsīnā nyajijñapat ||146|| devāca yāminīmāge paścime sukhanidritā | bhadrākṣaṃ ṣoḍaśa svapnānimānatyaṅgatodayān ||147|| gajendramavadātāṅgaṃ vṛṣamaṃ 'dundumisvanam | siṃhamulalitādyagraṃ lakṣmī snāpyāṃ suradvipaiḥ ||14|| dāminī lambamāne khe śītāṃśu ghotitāmbaram | proyantamabjinībandhu bandhuraṃ jhaṣayugmakam ||14|| kalasāvamṛtāpūrṇī saraḥ svacchāmbu sāmbujam | vārāśiṃ kṣumitāvarta saiṃha bhāsuramāsanam ||15|| vimānamāpatat svargād bhuvo #vanamudbhavat | rabarāśiṃ sphuradarśima jvalanaṃ prajvaladyutim ||351|| dṛṣṭratān ṣoḍaśasvapnānathādarśa mahīpate | vadanaṃ me viśanta taṃ gavendra kanakacchavim ||152|| vadeteṣāṃ phalaṃ deva śuśrūṣā me vivardate | apūrvadarśanāt kasya na syāt kautukavanmanaḥ ||153|| athāsāvavadhijñānavibuddhasvapnasatphalaḥ | provāca tatphalaṃ devyai lasaddaśanadīdhitiḥ ||154|| śṛṇu devi mahān putro bhavitā te gajekṣaṇāt | samastabhuvanajyeṣṭho mahāvṛṣamadarśanāt ||155|| siṃhenānannavīyaryo'sau dāmnā saddharmatīrthakṛt | lakṣyābhiṣekamātāsau meromūni surottamaiḥ ||156|| pūrṇendunā janāhādī māsvatā māsvarayutiḥ | kummābhyāṃ nidhimāgī syāt sukhī matsyayugekṣaṇāt||157|| sarasā lakṣaṇodbhāsī so'bdhinā kevalī bhavet | siṃhāsanena sāmrājyamavāpsyati jagadguruḥ ||15||
tadanantara vaha marudevī svapna dekhanese utpanna hue ānandako māno apane śarīrameṃ dhāraṇa karaneke lie samartha nahīṃ huī thī isīlie vaha maṃgalamaya snāna kara aura vastrābhūṣaṇa dhāraṇa kara apane patike samīpa pahu~cī ||14|| usane vahā~ jākara ucita vinayase mahārāja nābhirājake darśana kiye aura phira sukhapūrvaka baiṭhakara, rājyasiṃhāsanapara baiṭhe hue mahārājase isa prakāra nivedana kiyā ||146|| he deva, āja maiṃ sukhase so rahī thī, sote hī sote maiṃne rātrike pichale bhāgameṃ āścaryajanaka phala denevāle ye solaha svapna dekhe haiṃ ||147|| svaccha aura sapheda śarīra dhāraṇa karanevālā airāvata hāthī, dundubhike samāna śabda karatā huā baila, pahāḍa़kī coṭīko ullaṃghana karanevālā siṃha, devoṃke hāthiyoṃ dvārā nahalāyī gayī lakṣmī, ākāśameṃ laṭakatī huī do mālāe~, ākāśako prakāśamāna karatā huā candramā, udaya hotā huā sūrya, manohara machaliyoṃkā yugala, jalase bhare hue do kalaśa, svaccha jala aura kamaloṃse sahita sarovara, kṣubhita aura bha~varase yukta samudra, dedīpyamāna siṃhāsana, svargase ātā huā vimāna, pṛthivīse prakaṭa hotā huā nāgendrakā bhavana, prakāśamāna kiraṇoṃse śobhita ratnoṃkī rāśi aura jalatī huī dedīpyamāna agni| ina solaha svapnoṃko dekhaneke bāda he rājan, maiṃne dekhā hai ki eka savarṇake samāna pīlā baila mere mukhameṃ praveśa kara rahā hai| he deva, āpa ina svapnoṃka., phala kahie | inake phala sunanekī merī icchā nirantara baḍha़ rahī hai so ṭhīka hī hai apūrva vastuke dekhanese kisakā mana kautuka-yukta nahīṃ hotā hai ? ||148-153|| tadanantara, avadhijñānake dvārā jinhoṃne svapnoṃkā uttama phala jāna liyā hai aura jinakī dā~toṃkī kiraṇe atiśaya śobhāyamāna ho rahī haiṃ aise mahārāja nābhirāja marudevīke lie svapnoṃkā phala kahane lage ||154|| he devi, suna, hāthīke dekhanese tere uttama putra hogā, uttama baila dekhanese vaha samasta lokameṃ jyeṣṭha hogā ||15|| siṃhake dekhanese vaha ananta balase yukta hogā, mālāoṃke dekhanese samīcīna dharmake tīrtha (āmnāya) kā calānevālā hogā, lakṣmīke dekhanese vaha sumeru parvatake mastakapara devoṃke dvārā abhiṣekako prāpta hogā ||156|| pūrṇa candramāke dekhanese samasta logoṃko ānanda denevālā hogā, sūryake dekhanese dedīpyamāna prabhākā dhāraka hogā, do kalaśa dekhanese aneka nidhiyoṃko prāpta hogā, machaliyoṃkā yugala dekhanese sukhī hogā||157| sarovarake dekhanese aneka lakṣaṇoṃse śobhita hogā, samudrake dekhanese kevalī hogā, siṃhāsanake dekhanese jagatkā guru hokara sāmrājya.

aura aisī mālūma hotī thī māno use kisī dūsarī jagaha apanī icchānusāra sthāna prāpta nahīṃ huā thā isalie vaha ananya gati hokara bhagavānke śarīra meṃ ā prakaṭa huī ho || 27 || bhagavānakā śarīra svabhāvase hī sundara thā, vanamaya haḍa़iyoṃke bandhanase sahita thā, viṣa śastra ādise abhedya thā aura isīlie vaha meru prarvatakī kāntiko prāpta ho rahā thā ||28|| jisa saṃhananameṃ vajamayī haḍa़iyā~ vasoṃse veṣṭita hotī haiṃ aura vamayī kīloṃse kīlita hotī haiṃ, bhagavān vṛṣabhadevakā vahī vajavṛṣabhanārācasaṃhanana thā ||29|| vāta, pitta aura kapha ina tīna doṣoṃse utpanna huī vyādhiyā~ bhagavānake śarīra meṃ sthāna nahīṃ kara sakī thīṃ so ṭhīka hī hai vṛkṣa athavā anya parvatoṃkoṃ hilānevālī vāyu meru parvatapara apanā asara nahīṃ dikhā sakatī||30|| unake śarīra meṃ na kabhī buḍha़āpā ātā thā, na kabhī unheṃ kheda hotā thā aura na kabhī unakā upaghāta (asamayameṃ mṛtyu) hī ho sakatā thā| ve kevala sukhake adhīna hokara pṛthivīrūpī śayyāpara pūjita hote the || 31|| jo mahābhyudayarūpa mokṣakā mūla kāraṇa thā aisā bhagavānakā paramaudārika śarīra atyanta śobhāyamāna ho rahā thā ||32|| bhagavānke śarīrakā ākāra, lambāī-cauḍa़āī aura. ū~cāī ādi saba ora hīnādhikatāse rahita thā, unakā samacaturasrasaṃsthāna thā ||33||

ādipurāṇam yathārkasya samudbhutau nimittamudayācalaḥ | svatastu māsvānuvāti tathaivāsma' bhavānapi ||54|| garbhagehe śucau mātussvaṃ divye panaviṣṭare | nidhāya svāṃ parāṃ śaktimudbhūto niṣkalo'syataḥ ||59|| gurubuvo'haṃ tadeva svāmityabhyarthaya vibhum | marti vidhehi lokasya sarjanaṃ prati saṃprati ||30|| svāmādipuruṣaṃ dṛṣṭvā loko'pyevaṃ pravartatām | mahatāṃ mārgavattinyaḥ prajāḥ suprajaso hyamūḥ ||6|| tataḥ kalatramaśreṣṭaṃ pariṇetuṃ manaḥ kuru | prajāsantatiravaṃ hi nocchetsyati vidāṃvara ||6|| prajāsattasyavicchede tanute dharmasantatiḥ| manuṣva mānavaṃ"dharma tato devemamacyuta ||63||... devemaṃ gṛhiṇāṃ dharma viddhi dāraparigraham | santānarakṣaṇe yasna: kāryoṃ hi gṛhamedhinām ||6|| svayā gurumato'yaṃ cet janaḥ kenāpi hetunā | vaco nolsayamevāsya neṣṭaṃ hi gurulānam ||65|| ityudīrya giraṃ dhīro'"vyaraṃsībāmipārthivaḥ | devastu sasmitaṃ tasya vacaḥ pratyecchadomiti ||66|| kimetapitṛdākṣiṇyaṃ kiṃ prajānugrahaiṣitā | "niyogaḥ ko'pi vā tāga yenaicchattāraśaṃ vaśī ||6|| tato'syānumatiṃ jñātvā viśako nāmibhūpatiḥ | mahadvivāhakalyāṇamakarotparayā mudā ||6||

ādipurāṇam stanāmjakumale dīrgharomarājyakanālake | te paminyāvivāghattāṃ nīmacūcukaṣaṭpade ||40|| 'muktāhāreṇa tannanaṃ tapastepe svanāmajam | yato'vāpa sa taskaṇṭhakucasparśasukhāmṛtam ||41|| ekāvalyā stanopāntasparśinyā te viraṃjatuḥ | sakhyeva kaṇṭhasaṃginyā svacchayā snigdhamukkayā ||2 hāraṃ nakṣatramālākhyaṃ te stanāntaralambinam | dadhatuḥ kucasaṃsparśāddhasantamiva rociṣā ||43|| mṛda bhujalate cāā vadhiṣātāṃ susaṃhate | nakhāṃśukusumo de daṃdhāne hasitaśriyam ||84|| mukhendurenayoḥ kāntimadhānmugdhasmitāṃśubhiḥ | jyotsnālakṣmī samātanvan jagatāṃ kāntadarśanaḥ||5|| supaśmaṇī tayorne rejāte smigdhatārakaṃ | yathorapale samutphulle kesarālagnaṣaṭpade ||86|| 'nāmakarmavinirmāṇarucire subhruvorbuvā| cāpayaṣṭiranaṅgasya nānuyātumalaṃ tarām ||47|| athavā romarājirūpī latāke mūlameṃ cāroṃ orase baṃdhā huā pāla hī ho ||79|| jisa prakāra kamalinī kamalapuṣpakī boḍa़iyoṃko dhāraṇa karatī hai usī prakāra ve deviyā~ stanarūpī kamalakī boṃḍa़iyoṃko dhāraṇa kara rahī thīṃ, kamaliniyoṃke kamala jisa prakāra eka nālase sahita hote haiṃ usī prakāra unake stanarūpī kamala bhī romarājirūpī eka nālase sahita the aura kamalopara jisa prakāra bhaure baiṭhate haiṃ usī prakāra unake stanarūpī kamaloṃpara bhī cūcukarūpī bhauṃre baiṭhe hue the| isa prakāra ve donoṃ hī deviyā~ ṭhīka kamaliniyoṃke samāna suśobhita ho rahī thīṃ ||8|| unake gale meṃ jo muktāhāra arthāt motiyoṃke hāra paḍa़e hue the, mālūma hotā hai ki unhoṃne avaśya hī apane nāmake anusāra (mukta+āhāra) āhāra-tyāga arthāt upavāsarūpa tapa tapā thā aura isīlie una muktāhāroṃne apane ukta tapake phalasvarūpa una deviyoṃke kaṇṭha aura kucake sparśase utpanna hue sukharūpī amṛtako prāpta kiyā thā ||1||
gale meṃ paḍa़e hue ekāvalī arthāt eka laḍa़ke hārase ve donoṃ aisī śobhāyamāna ho rahī thīṃ māno kisī sakhīke sambandhase hī śobhāyamāna ho rahī hoṃ kyoṃki jisa prakāra sakhī stanoṃke samīpavartī bhāgakā sparśa karatī hai usī prakāra vaha ekāvalī bhī unake stanoṃke samīpavartī bhāgakā sparśa kara rahī thī, sakhī jisa prakāra kaṇṭhase saṃsarga rakhatī hai arthāt kaṇṭhāliṃgana karatī hai usī prakāra vaha ekāvalī bhī unake kaṇṭhase saṃsarga rakhatī thī arthāt kaṇṭhameṃ paḍa़ī huī thī, sakhī jisa prakāra svaccha arthāt kapaṭarahita-nirmalahṛdaya hotī hai usī prakāra vaha ekāvalī bhī svaccha-nirmala thī aura sakhī jisa prakāra snigdhamuktā hotī hai arthāt snehī pati ke dvārā

ādipurāṇam anaṅgatvena tannūnamenayoḥ praviśan vapuḥ | durgāśrita ivānako vivyādhainaṃ svasāyakaiḥ ||9|| tābhyāmiti samaṃ bhogān bhujhānasya jagadguroḥ | kālo mahānagādekakṣaṇavad satatakṣaṇa:2 ||19|| athānyadā mahādevī saudhe suptā yaśasvati | svapne'paśyan mahīṃ prastāṃ meruṃ sūrya ca soḍupam ||100|| saraḥ sahasamabdhi cacaladvīcikamaikṣata | svapnānte ca vyabuddhāsau paṭhan māgadhaniḥsvanaiḥ ||10|| tvaṃ vibudhyasva kalyāṇi kalyāṇaśatamāgini | prabodhasamayo'yaṃ te sahājinyā dhṛtaśriyaḥ ||10|| mude tavāmba bhūyāsurime svapnāḥ śubhāvahāḥ | mahīmerūdadhīndusarobarapurassarāḥ ||103|| namassarovare'viṣya ciraṃ timiraśaivalam | khedādivānāmyeti śaśihaṃso'sta pādapam || jyotsnāmmasi ciraṃ tī tārāhasyo namo de| nūnaṃ niletumastāḥ śikharāṇyāśrayantyamūḥ||105|| nidrākaṣāyitainaḥ kokīnāṃsegramīkṣitaḥ | tadṛṣṭiṣitārameva vidhudhirachāyatāṃ gataḥ ||16|| prayāti yāminī yāmā nivānvetuṃ purogatān | jyotsnāṃśukaṃna saṃveṣṭya tārāsarvasvamāgmanaḥ ||10|| ito'stamati śītāṃśurito bhāsvānudīyate | saṃsārasyeva vaicitryamupadaṃṣṭusamudyatau ||10||
